8Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ nɔ ko kɛ je mi ni lemi kɛ yaka sisimi ko ngɔ nyɛ nyɔgue, ngɛ nimli a blema sanehi kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi mumihi nɛ ji Kristo mi ɔ nya. 9Ejakaa e mi Mawu fuu hyimi ɔ kulaa hii ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso su mi; 10nɛ nyɛ hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ e mi, lɛ nɔ nɛ ji nɔkɔtɔma yemi kɛ he blɔ tsuo yi ɔ, 11nɔ mi nɛ a po nyɛ hu ngɛ, kɛ nɔ pomi nɛ pi he lo mi pomi, se mohu Kristo pomi nɛ jeɔ wɔ kɛ jee he lo nɔmlɔ tso yayami mi ɔ; 12ejakaa a pu nyɛ ngɔ piɛ e he ngɛ baptisimi ɔ mi, nɔ mi hu nɛ a tle nyɛ si ngɛ, ngɛ Mawu nɛ tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ he wami ni tsumi ɔ nɔ hemi kɛ yemi nya a. 13Nɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ji ni gbogboehi ngɛ nyɛ nɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛ he lo mɔmlɔtɔ ɔ mi ɔ, e ha nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ tsuo wami, nɛ e kɛ nyɛ nɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ kulaa pa nyɛ; 14nɛ e gba wa he womi nɛ a ngma, nɛ ngɛ Mlaa amɛ a mi nɛ da si si wɔ ɔ, nɛ kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu e je ngɛ kpɛti kɛ ho, nɛ e ka ngɔ mɛtɛ sɛumi tso ɔ he. 15E kplɔ nɔkɔtɔma yemihi kɛ he blɔ ɔmɛ a he nihi, nɛ e bɔ mɛ ahlua pãa, nɛ e sã mɛ kɛ nyɛɛ e se ngɛ e kunimi yemi ɔ mi.
16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ kojo nyɛ ngɛ ni yeni, loo ni numi, loo nyami ligbi, loo hluami he, loo Hejɔɔmi Ligbihi a blɔfami, 17ejakaa nihi nɛ maa ba amɛ a he nini kɛkɛ ʼi, se nɔmlɔ tso ɔ ji Kristo nɔ ɔ nɛ. 18Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ buu e he kaa e pe nihi kulaa ngɛ ni nami ko he ɔ nɛ bu nyɛ fɔ nɛ e fi nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e hlami nya kaa a kɛ he si bami juɛmi nɛ ja hiɔwe bɔfohi; e he lo juɛmi ɔ hãa e woɔ e he nɔ yakatsuaa; 19kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ, e hɛɛ we Kristo nɛ ji yi ɔ mi, nɔ mi nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kulaa naa nihi nɛ hiaa lɛ, kɛ guu kpɔjihi kɛ panihi a nɔ kɛ waa bɔ nɛ Mawu to ɔ.
Gbomi kɛ wami ngɛ Kristo mi
20Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ke nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo gbo kɛ ha je nɛ ɔ mi sisije ni ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ haa a woɔ nyɛ mlaa kɛ mwɔɔ ke: 21“Koo pɛtɛ he, nɛ koo sa o nya, nɛ koo ta he tete” ɔ? 22Jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ kulaa a, a he ni tsumi mi nɔuu a hɛ mi kpataa ngɛ, ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji nimli a kitahi kɛ tsɔɔmihi, 23nɛ a ji nihi nɛ hɛɛ ni lemi munyu ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya jami kɛ he si bami juɛmi kɛ nɔmlɔ tso yi mi wami mi mohu, se a pi nihi nɛ he ngɛ se nami nɛ kuɔ he lo ɔ he numi nihi a nya.

english_text:
1 You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side. 2Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth. 3You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God. 4Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
5Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols. 6God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things. 7And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way. 8But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others. 9 And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
10 Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better. 11It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
12 God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient. 13 Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you. 14Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
15Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful. 16 Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God. 17Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him.
Some Rules for Christian Living
18 A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
19 A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
20 Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
21 Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
22 Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart. 23Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master. 24In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you. 25 But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_text:
1Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke a tle nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo si ɔ, nyɛ hla nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, he nɛ Kristo ngɛ nɛ e hii si ngɛ Mawu hiɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ. 2Nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔmɛ a he nyɛ susu, pi nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ. 3Ejakaa nyɛ gbo nɛ a ngɔ nyɛ wami ɔ kɛ Kristo tsuo ngɔ laa ngɛ Mawu mi. 4Benɛ Kristo, nɔ nɛ ji wa wami ɔ ma pue ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ma pue ngɛ anuminyami mi.
Wami momo kɛ ehe ɔ
5Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ gbe nyɛ he nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ: ajuama bɔmi, mu ni tsumi, mi mi la, akɔnɔ yaya, kɛ hɛ tsumi nɛ ji wɔ jami ɔ, 6nihi a he nɛ Mawu muklii mi fumi baa tuegbenɔ bi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, 7nihi a mi nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ nyɛɛ sa, benɛ nyɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ peɔ ja amɛ a kpɛti ɔ.
8Se jehanɛ ɔ nyɛ hu nyɛ sake kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa ngɔ pue he, nihi nɛ ji muklii mi fumi, mi mi la, hetsɛ, musu bɔmi munyu, zo munyu ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ nya mi. 9Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ sibi lakpa, ejakaa nyɛ je nɔmlɔ momo ɔ kɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ ngɔ pue he; 10nyɛɛ wo nɔmlɔ he nɛ plɛɔ ehe ekohu kɛ yaa ni lemi mi ngɛ nɔ nɛ bɔ lɛ ɔ subai ɔ nya; 11he nɛ Hela no kɛ Yuda no, nɔ nɛ a po lɛ kɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ, jekɔno kɛ Skite no, nyɔguɛ kɛ odehe ko be hu, se mohu Kristo ji nihi kulaa ngɛ nihi kulaa mi ɔ.
12Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ bimɛ nɛ Mawu hia, ni klɔuklɔuhi kɛ suɔli ji nyɛ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ wo mi mi jɔmi, mɔbɔ nami, he si bami, kpoo peemi, tsui si tomi kaa tade, 13nɛ ke nɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko na sane ko ɔ, nyɛɛ na ha nyɛ sibi nɛ nyɛ kɛ pa nyɛ he, kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu kɛ pa nyɛ ɔ, ja nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee. 14Se enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo se ɔ, nyɛɛ wo suɔmi nɛ ji kpa nɛ fiɔ nihi kulaa peɔ kake ɔ kaa tade. 15Nɛ nyɛ ha Mawu he jɔmi ɔ nɛ ye tsɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi, nɔ́ nɛ he nɛ a tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso kake mi ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ le si nami. 16Nyɛ ha Kristo munyu ɔ nɛ hi nyɛ mi babauu ngɛ ni lemi tsuaa ni lemi mi; nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ he ni nɛ nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ he ngɛ saku fiamihi kɛ yi jemi lahi kɛ mumi mi lahi a mi, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ sina nɛ la ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi ha Mawu. 17Nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ngɛ munyu tumi loo ni tsumi blɔfami ɔ, nyɛɛ pee kulaa ngɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ gu e nɔ kɛ na Mawu kɛ Tsɛ ɔ si.
Wami he ɔ mi sihimi
18Yigbayi, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɔ ha nyɛ hunomɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi. 19Hunomɛ, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ yihi, nɛ nyɛ yi mi ko wa ngɛ a nɔ.
20Bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ fɔli a tue ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ blɔfami, ejakaa kɔlɔ ɔ lɛ sa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi saminya.
21Tsɛmɛ, nyɛ ko wo nyɛ bihi a muklii mi la, konɛ a nine mi nɛ ko wo nyu.
22Sɔmɔli, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ he lo blɔfami nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a tue ngɛ nihi kulaa mi, pi kɛ hɛ mi sɔmɔmi, kaa nihi nɛ hlaa nimli a hɛ mi nyami, se mohu ngɛ tsui kpakpa mi kaa nihi nɛ yee Mawu gbeye. 23Nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, nyɛɛ je nyɛ tsui mi kɛ pee, kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ pee kɛ ngɛ hae se pi nimli, 24nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi nyɛ nine maa su gbo si ni ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ kaa nyɛ hiɔwo, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo nyɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe. 25Nɔ nɛ peɔ nihi nɛ dɛ́ blɔ ɔ ma na nihi nɛ dɛ́ blɔ ɔ he hiɔwo, nɛ hɛ mi hyemi ko be mi.

english_text:
1 Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
2Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful. 3Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this. 4Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
5 When you are with unbelievers, always make good use of the time. 6 Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions.
Final Greetings
7 Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me. 8I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along. 9 Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
10 Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you. 11Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
12 Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely. 13I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
14 Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
15Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
16After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
17 Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
18I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
Don't forget that I am in jail.
I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_text:
1Nyɔmtsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa pɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ nyɔmtsɛ ngɛ hiɔwe.
Nyagbe gawomi
2Nyɛɛ sɔle daa, nyɛɛ fɔ nyɔ ngɛ mi kɛ sina; 3nɛ jehanɛ snyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ hulɔ, konɛ Mawu nɛ bli munyu ɔ sinya a ha wɔ nɛ wa kɛ fiɛ Kristo laami sane ɔ, nɔ́ he nɛ i fɔɔ si ngɛ kpa mi nɛ ɔ, 4konɛ ma je kɔlɔ ɔ si paa bɔ nɛ da kaa ma de ɔ.
5Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ ni lemi nya, ngɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ se ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ tsu nyɛ deka a he ni. 6Nyɛ ha nyɛ munyu he nɛ tsɔ daa, nɛ ngo nɛ hi mi, nɛ nyɛɛ le bɔ nɛ sa kaa nyɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ heto.
Nyagbe sɛyemi
7Tihiko, nɛ ji suɔmi nyɛmi kɛ anɔkuale sɔmɔlɔ kɛ huɛ tsɔlɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, maa bɔ nyɛ ye he sane ɔmɛ tsuo. 8Enɛ ɔ he nɔuu nɛ i tsɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ, konɛ ma nu nyɛ he, nɛ e wo nyɛ bua, 9nɛ i ngɔ Onesimo nɛ ji anɔkualetsɛ kɛ nyɛmi nɛ a suɔ nɛ je nyɛ kpɛti ɔ ngɔ piɛ e he; a ma ba bɔ nyɛ hiɛ ɔ sanehi kulaa.
10Aristarko, ye huɛ pa mi no ɔ, kɛ Marko nɛ ji Barnaba nyɛmi bi ɔ, (nɔ nɛ he nɛ nyɛ na womi ɔmɛ ɔ, ke e ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ he lɛ hɛmuɔ), 11kɛ Yesu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yusto ɔ, nihi nɛ je ninɛmɛ nɛ a po mɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, ke a biɔ nyɛ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ pɛ ji ye huɛmɛ ni tsuli ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he; a ji bua womi kɛ ha mi.
12Epafra nɛ je nyɛ kpɛti nɛ ji Kristo sɔmɔlɔ nɛ daa nɛ ɔ e kaii nyɛ ngɛ e sɔlemihi a mi, konɛ nyɛɛ da si nɛ nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si nɛ nyɛ hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya nihi kulaa mi ɔ, ke e biɔ nyɛ. 13I ngɛ e he odase yee kaa e gboɔ dengme wawɛɛ ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Laodikea kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Hierapoli ɔmɛ a he. 14Luka, tsopatsɛ nɛ a suɔ ɔ, kɛ Dema ke a biɔ nyɛ.
15Wa biɔ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Laodikea a, kɛ Nimfa kɛ asafo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ. 16Nɛ ke a kane womi nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha a kane ngɛ Laodikea asafo ɔ mi hulɔ, nɛ a ha nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kane Laodikea nɔ ɔ. 17Nɛ nyɛ de Arkipo ke: “Hyɛ nɛ o tsu sɔmɔmi ni tsumi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo o dɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɛ o gbe nya kɛ pi si!”
18Imi Paulo nitsɛ ye nine nya womi nɛ i ngma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ kai ye kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ! Dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_text:
1 From Paul, Silas, and Timothy.
To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
2We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray, 3we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
4My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people. 5When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you. 6 So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
7You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia. 8And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it. 9Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God. 10They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_text:
1Paulo kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo ngma ya ha Tesalonika asafo nɛ ngɛ Mawu, Tsɛ ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Tesalonikabi ɔmɛ a sihihii kɛ a hemi kɛ yemi
2Wa naa Mawu si daa ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he, nɛ wa woɔ nyɛ ta ngɛ wa pɛɛ kpamihi a mi, nɛ wa jɔɔ we. 3Wa kaii nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ni tsumi ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛ suɔmi mɔde bɔmi ɔ kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi mi tsui si tomi ɔ ngɛ Mawu kɛ wa Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi. 4Ejakaa mamimɛ nɛ Mawu suɔ, wa le hlami nɛ a hla nyɛ ɔ, 5kaa wa sane kpakpa a bɛ́ nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ munyu tumi mi kɛkɛ, se mohu ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he wami kɛ nɔ mi mami babauu mi, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le, bɔ nɛ wa plɛ ba wa je mi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ. 6Nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ plɛ waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kaseli, akɛnɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu mi bua jɔmi he munyu ɔ ngɛ dengme babauu mi ɔ, 7nɛ e ha nyɛ plɛ okadi ha nihi kulaa nɛ he ye ngɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia a. 8Ejakaa nyɛ ngɔ Nyɔmtsɛ munyu ɔ je nɛ e gbɛ fia, pi ngɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia kɛkɛ, se mohu nyɛ hemi nɛ nyɛ heɔ Mawu nɔ yeɔ ɔ jije kɛ ho he tsuaa he ya, nɛ e hia we wɔ nɔ́ ko demi tete. 9Ejakaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbɛ wa slaami ɔ he munyu ɔ fia kɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ kpale kɛ je amagahi a he kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ nɛ nyɛ ba sɔmɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ, 10nɛ nyɛ ngɛ e bi ɔ nɛ e tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ blɔ hyɛe kɛ je hiɔwe, Yesu ne je wɔ kɛ je mi mi fumi nɛ maa ba a mi ɔ.

english_text:
Paul's Work in Thessalonica
1My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted. 2 As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble. 3We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone. 4God was pleased to trust us with his message. We didn't speak to please people, but to please God who knows our motives.
5You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed. 6We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us. 7But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby. 8We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
9My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone. 10Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord. 11You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children. 12We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
13We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you. 14 My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
15 Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else. 16They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them.
Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
17My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person. 18We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us. 19After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us? 20You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_text:
Paulo nitsumi ngɛ Tesalonika
1Mamimɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa slaami nɛ wa ba slaa nyɛ ɔ pee we yaka, 2se mohu wa na ka ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ mi, nɛ waa kɛ fiɛ Mawu sane kpakpa a tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ nya tsimi babauu mi; pohu wa na nɔ kɛ be, nɛ a wa wɔ yi mi hulɔ ngɛ Filipi, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ. 3Ejakaa wa munyu tumi kɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ, pi sisimi loo mu ni tsumi loo lakpa mi nɛ e je; 4se mohu kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu bu wɔ nihi nɛ sa kaa a tu sane kpakpa a ngɔ wo wa dɛ mi ɔ, ja wa deɔ, pi bɔ nɛ sa nimli a hɛ mi, se mohu bɔ nɛ sa Mawu nɛ kaa tsuihi hyɛ ɔ hɛ mi. 5Ejakaa wa tu we nya mi ngɔngɔɛ munyu ko hyɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, nɛ wa to we hɛ tsumi he lakpa ko hulɔ, Mawu ji odase; 6jehanɛ wa hla we nimli a hɛ mi nyami ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ aloo ni kpa komɛ a ngɔ, 7pohu wa ngɛ he blɔ kaa waa kɛ wa he fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ, akɛnɛ Kristo bɔfohi ji wɔ ɔ. Se mohu wa mi mi jɔɔ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, kaa bɔ nɛ bimɛ a nyɛ hɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e bimɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ ɔ. 8Akɛnɛ wa suɔ nyɛ saminya he je ɔ, wa ngɛ he tsui kaa pi Mawu sane kpakpa a kɛkɛ nɛ waa kɛ ma ha nyɛ, se mohu wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa wami tete, ejakaa wa suɔ nyɛ wawɛɛ.
9Mamimɛ, nyɛ hɛ ngɛ wa pɔtɔ kɛ wa dengme gbomi ɔ nɔ, kaa benɛ pee nɛ wa ko pee tlomi ngɔ ha nyɛ ti nɔ ko he je ɔ, nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo wa ngɛ ni tsue, nɛ wa pa ngɛ Mawu sane kpakpa a jajee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe. 10Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ kɛ Mawu ji odase yeli kaa wa je mi nɛ wa ba ngɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ he yeɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ ngɛ klɔuu, e da, nɛ piami ko be he. 11Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ wa hɛɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ tsɛ ko hɛɛ e bimɛ. 12Wa wo nyɛ he wami, wa wo nyɛ bua, nɛ wa su nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ nyɛɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu nɛ tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e matsɛ yemi kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ mi ɔ hɛ mi.
13Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ wɔ hu wa naa Mawu si nɛ wa jɔɔ we ɔ nɛ, ejakaa benɛ nyɛ nine su Mawu munyu nɛ nyɛ nu ngɛ wa nya a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ pɛtɛ he kaa Mawu munyu, kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hu niinɛ ɔ, se pi kaa nimli a munyu ko ʼi; se mohu e ji Mawu munyu nɛ tsuɔ he wami nihi ngɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti. 14Ejakaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ, mamimɛ, nyɛ plɛ Mawu asafo nɛ ngɛ Yudea a kaseli ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi, ejakaa dengme nɛ nyɛ na ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu mɛ hu a na ngɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, 15nihi nɛ gbe Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbali ɔmɛ hulɔ, nɛ a waa wɔ hu yi mi, nɛ a sɛ́ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ nimli tsuo yi, 16nihi nɛ tsiɔ wɔ blɔ hulɔ kaa wa ko tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ maje li ɔmɛ konɛ a he a yi wami. Enɛ ɔ a kɛ woɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ fuu tɔ daa nɔ; se jehanɛ Mawu mi mi fumi na mɛ.
Paulo suɔ nɛ e ya slaa Tesalonikabi ɔmɛ ekohu
17Se wɔɔ lɛɛ, mamimɛ, akɛnɛ waa kɛ nyɛ mi gba be kpiti ko ngɛ he lo mi se pi tsui mi he je ɔ, waa kɛ hɛja babauu bɔ mɔde nitsɛ konɛ waa na nyɛ hɛ mi ekohu. 18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa hla kaa waa ba nyɛ ngɔ — imi, Paulo ɔ, i hla si kake kɛ si enyɔ sɔuu — se Satan tsi wɔ blɔ. 19Ejakaa mɛni ji wa hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi loo wa bua jɔmi loo wa fiami jlasi ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo hɛ mi ngɛ e bami be ɔ mi ɔ? Anɛ pi nyɛ nɔuu lo? 20Ejakaa nyɛ nyɛ ji wa hɛ mi nyami kɛ wa bua jɔmi.

english_text:
1 Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves 2and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you. 3We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer, 4because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know. 5At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
6 Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
7My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you. 8Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life. 9How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us? 10Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
11We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you. 12May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown. 13And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_text:
1Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ wa nyɛ we hu ɔ, wa kplɛɛ kaa a je wa he kɛkɛ ngɛ Ateene, 2nɛ wa tsɔ wa nyɛmi Timoteo, nɛ ji Mawu sɔmɔlɔ kɛ wa huɛ ni tsulɔ ngɛ Kristo sane kpakpa a mi ɔ, konɛ e ba wo nyɛ he wami nɛ e ha nyɛ fi si ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, 3konɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔ nami nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nane nɛ kpata. Ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa nɔ́ nɛ fɔɔ si ha wɔ nɔuu ji kɔlɔ ɔ nɛ. 4Benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, wa de nyɛ ngɔ to ke wa maa na nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ba mi nɛ nyɛ le ɔ. 5Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ imi hu, benɛ i nyɛ we hu ɔ, i tsɔ konɛ ma kɛ le nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ, kaa alinɔ nɔ kalɔ ɔ ba ka nyɛ nɛ e ha wa dengme nɛ wa gbo ɔ pee yaka lo?
6Se jehanɛ nɛ Timoteo je nyɛ ngɔ ba wa ngɔ nɛ e ba bɔ wɔ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ kɛ nyɛ suɔmi kɛ kaimi kpakpa nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ kaii wɔ daa a, kɛ nyɛ hɛ̃ nɛ ngɛ jae kaa nyɛ ma na wɔ kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa hɛ̃ jaa ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ, 7e nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, mamimɛ, wa nɔ nami kɛ wa haomi ɔmɛ kulaa mi ɔ, nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ha wa bua jɔ ngɛ nyɛ he. 8Jehanɛ wa na he wami he, akɛnɛ nyɛ daa si ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ. 9Kɛ wa maa na Mawu si ngɛ nyɛ he ngɛ bua jɔmi tsuo nɛ wa na ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ hɛ mi ɔ he kɛɛ? 10Nyɔ kɛ pia kulaa wa kpaa pɛɛ babauu, konɛ waa na nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ wa ha nyɛ nɔ nɛ piɛ ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ.
11Jehanɛ, Mawu kɛ wa Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ kɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ ha wa blɔ ɔ nɛ da kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ. 12Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ wo nyɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ, nɛ e ha nyɛɛ be nɔ kɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ suɔ nyɛ he kɛ nihi kulaa a, kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa suɔ nyɛ ɔ; 13benɛ pee nɛ e ha nyɛ tsui nɛ pi si ngɛ klɔuklɔu peemi mi nɛ piami ko ko hi nyɛ he, ngɛ Mawu kɛ wa Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo kɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kulaa a bami be ɔ mi.

english_text:
A Life That Pleases God
1Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder. 2Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus. 3God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex. 4Respect and honor your wife. 5Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God. 6You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things. 7God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure. 8So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
9We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this, 10and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more. 11Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do. 12 Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone.
The Lord's Coming
13My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope. 14We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died. 15 Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
16 With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life. 17Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever. 18Encourage each other with these words.
translation_text:
Sihimi nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi
1Nyagbe ɔ, mamimɛ, wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nɛ wa ngɛ nyɛ ga woe ngɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu mi, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ kase kɛ je wa ngɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ sa kaa nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi ha ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee hulɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɔ ja. 2Ejakaa nyɛ le kita nɛ wa wo nyɛ ngɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu biɛ mi ɔ. 3Enɛ ɔ ji Mawu suɔmi nya ni kaa nyɛ he nɛ tsɔ, lɔ ɔ ji kaa nyɛɛ tsi nyɛ he nya kɛ je ajuama bɔmi he, 4nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ ɔ hɛɛmi ngɛ he tsɔmi kɛ bu mi, 5pi ngɛ akɔnɔ hɛ dɔmi mi, kaa bɔ nɛ maje li a bimɛ nɛ li Mawu ɔ peɔ ɔ; 6konɛ nɔ ko ko ye e nyɛmi amimi nɛ e sisi lɛ ngɛ sane ko mi ejakaa enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he tue gblalɔ ji Mawetsɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ wa de nyɛ ngɔ to nɛ wa ye he odase ɔ. 7Ejakaa Mawu tsɛ we wɔ ngɔ hi mu ni tsumi, se mohu he tsɔmi. 8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jehanɛ, nɔ nɛ bui tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ ɔ, pi nɔmlɔ ko nɛ e bui ɔ, se mohu Mawu nɔ nɛ ngɔ e Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɔ wo nyɛ mi ɔ ʼi.
9E hia we kaa ma ngma nyɛ ngɛ nyɛmimɛ a suɔmi he, ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ, Mawu tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he; 10ejakaa nyɛ peɔ ja hulɔ haa nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Makedonia tsuo kulaa a. Se wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, mamimɛ, kaa nyɛɛ ya nɔ pe kekle ɔ, 11nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ hi si kpoo nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ko wo ni kpahi a sane mi, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nine nɛ tsu ni, kaa bɔ nɛ wa de nyɛ ɔ, 12konɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi bɔ nɛ ngɛ fɛu ngɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ se ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ko hia nyɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami
13Se, mamimɛ, wa suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le ninɛmɛ nɛ a gbo ɔmɛ a he sane, konɛ nyɛ ko ye kɔmɔ kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ be hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ko ɔ. 14Ejakaa ke wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu gbo nɛ e te si ɔ, ja nɔuu Mawu maa gu Yesu nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔmɛ hu ngɔ piɛ e he kɛ ba.
15Wa ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ko nya, kaa wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa hɛ maa hi ngmengmle nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami be ɔ mi ɔ, be ninɛmɛ nɛ a gbo ɔmɛ a hlami sɛe. 16Ejakaa lɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ kɛ ose hemi kɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɔkɔtɔma gbi kɛ Mawu titimati maa je hiɔwe kɛ kple si, nɛ ni gbogboehi nɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ kekle maa te si, 17lɔ ɔ se ɔ, wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ma sa waa kɛ mɛ kulaa ngɛ bɔkuhi a mi kɛ maa ya Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kpeemi ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi, nɛ jã waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa hi si daa. 18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ kɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ wo nyɛ bua.

english_text:
1I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen. 2 You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night. 3People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
4My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief. 5You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark. 6Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert. 7People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk. 8 But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
9God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ. 10Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes. 11This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing.
Final Instructions and Greetings
12My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord. 13Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other. 14My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone. 15Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
16Always be joyful 17and never stop praying. 18Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
19Don't turn away God's Spirit 20or ignore prophecies. 21Put everything to the test. Accept what is good 22and don't have anything to do with evil.
23I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns. 24The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
25Friends, please pray for us.
26Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
27In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
28I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_text:
Nyɛ dla nyɛ he ngɔ to Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami ɔ
1Se be kɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, mamimɛ, e hia we kaa waa ngma nyɛ. 2Ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le tutuutu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ maa ba kaa juɔ baa nyɔ mi ɔ. 3Ejakaa be mi nɛ a ma de ke: “He jɔmi ngɛ, nɛ wa ngɛ sɔkee!” ɔ, lɛ be ɔ mi nɔuu hɛ mi kpatami ma ba tua mɛ si kake too, kaa kɔɔmi tuaa yo nɛ muklii wa a, nɛ a be mi jee gblegbleegblee. 4Se, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be diblii mi nɛ ligbi ɔ ma ba ti nyɛ si kaa juɔ. 5Ejakaa nyɛ tsuo ɔ la bimɛ ji nyɛ kɛ piani bimɛ hulɔ; wa pi nyɔ loo diblii bimɛ. 6Lɛɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ha waa hwɔ mahɛ kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ, se mohu nyɛ ha waa fɔ nyɔ nɛ wa hɛ nɛ ka si. 7Ejakaa ninɛmɛ nɛ hwɔɔ mahɛ ɔ, nyɔ mi a hwɔɔ, nɛ nihi nɛ deɔ da a, nyɔ mi a deɔ. 8Se wɔɔ lɛɛ akɛnɛ piani bimɛ ji wɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ ha wa hɛ nɛ ka si, nɛ waa wo hemi kɛ yemi kɛ suɔmi dama a, nɛ wa bu dade pɛɛ nɛ ji yi wami hemi hɛ kɛ nɔfɔmi ɔ. 9Ejakaa Mawu to we wɔ ha mi mi fumi, se mohu e to wɔ nɛ wa na yi wami hemi ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo mi, 10nɔ nɛ gbo wa yi gbenɔ konɛ wa hɛ ngɛ jio, wa gbo jio, waa kɛ lɛ nɛ hi si. 11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ wo nyɛ sibi he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ ye bua mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ.
Nyagbe gawomi kɛ sɛyemi
12Se, mamimɛ, wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ kaa znyɛɛ le nihi nɛ tsuɔ ni ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ a ji nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi nɛ a tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, 13nɛ nyɛɛ bu mɛ saminya ngɛ suɔmi mi ngɛ a ni tsumi ɔ he. Nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
14Wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ he jɔli ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ wo ninɛmɛ nɛ fɔɔ ɔmɛ he wami; nyɛɛ ye bua ninɛmɛ nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si ha nihi kulaa. 15Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi konɛ nɔ ko ko ngɔ yayami ngɔ to yayami nane mi, se mohu daa nɛ ɔ nyɛɛ di kpakpa peemi se ngɔ ha nyɛ he kɛ nihi kulaa.
16Nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ daa; 17nyɛɛ sɔle be tsuaa be; 18nyɛɛ na si ngɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mi; ejakaa lɔ ɔ ji Mawu suɔmi nya ni ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ngɛ nyɛ blɔfami.
19Nyɛ ko gbe Mumi ɔ; 20nyɛ ko bu gbali ɔmɛ a munyu ɔmɛ kaa pi nɔ́ ko nɛ sa bumi. 21Nyɛɛ ka nihi kulaa hyɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ hi ɔ, nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he. 22Nyɛɛ sa nyɛ he kɛ je nɔ́ fɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ hɛɛ yayami su ɔ he.
23He jɔmi Mawu ɔ nitsɛ nɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he kulaa kɛ pi si, nɛ e hyɛ nyɛ mumi kɛ nyɛ klaa kɛ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kulaa nɔ nɛ piami ko ko hi he ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo bami be ɔ mi. 24Anɔkualetsɛ ji Mawu nɛ tsɛɔ nyɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ lɛ nɔuu e maa pee hulɔ.
25Mamimɛ, nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ha wɔ.
26Nyɛ nga nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ nya he fiɔmi klɔuklɔu.
27I ngɛ nyɛ kita kae ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi kaa nyɛ ha a kane kikɛmɛ a womi nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛmimɛ klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kulaa!
28Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_text:
1 From Paul, Silas, and Timothy.
To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
2I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
When Christ Returns
3My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time. 4This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
5All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering. 6It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble, 7but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels 8and with a flaming fire.
Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message. 9 Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength. 10This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
11God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do. 12Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_text:
1Paulo kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo ngma ya ha Tesalonika asafo nɛ ngɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ:
2Dloomi kɛ hejɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Kojomi ngɛ Kristo bami be ɔ mi
3E sa kaa wa naa Mawu si daa ngɛ nyɛ he bɔ nɛ sa, mamimɛ, ejakaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ klee wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ suɔmi nɛ e kɛ suɔ e nyɛmimɛ ɔ ngɛ hiɛe kɛ ngɛ nɔ yae hulɔ, 4lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ tete wa fiaa ngɔ fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ Mawu asafo ɔmɛ a mi, ngɛ nyɛ tsui si tomi kɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi mi nɛ a waa kɛ nyɛ nɔ namihi nɛ nyɛ miaa nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ mi ɔmɛ a he.
5Enɛ ɔ ji Mawu kojomi nɛ da a he okadi nɛ a naa paa, konɛ a bu nyɛ kaa nyɛ sa Mawu matsɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ nae ngɛ he ɔ. 6E da ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ haoe ɔ, e maa hao mɛ ngɔ to nane mi; 7nɛ nyɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ haoe ɔ, e ma ha waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo he jɔɔmi, benɛ a ma je Mawetsɛ Yesu kpo kɛ maa je hiɔwe kɛ e he wami bɔfo ɔmɛ ɔ, 8nɔ nɛ kɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe maa gbla nihi nɛ li Mawu kɛ nihi nɛ bui wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo sane kpakpa a tue ɔmɛ a tue. 9A ma na hiɔwo nɛ ji neneene hɛ mi kpatami kɛ maa je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ e he wami ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ he, 10benɛ e maa ba nɛ a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a maa na e nyakpɛ nihi ngɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ he e nɔ ye ɔ kulaa mi ngɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, ejakaa a he wa dase nɛ wa ye ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ ye.
11Enɛ ɔ he je hu nɛ wa kpaa pɛɛ daa haa nyɛ ɔ nɛ, konɛ wa Mawu ɔ nɛ ha nyɛɛ sa tsɛmi ɔ, nɛ ngɛ e he wami nya a, e ha nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa tsuaa nɔ́ kpakpa kɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi, 12benɛ pee nɛ a wo wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami ngɛ e mi, ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ nya.

english_text:
The Lord's Return
1 When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends, 2not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters. 3But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear. 4 He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God. 5Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
6You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come. 7His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way. 8 Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
9 When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs. 10Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it. 11So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie. 12All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth.
Be Faithful
13My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth. 14God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ. 15My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
16God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father 17will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_text:
Dikalɔ ɔ
1Ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo bami ɔ kɛ wa nya nɛ a ma bua ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, mamimɛ, 2kaa nyɛ ko ha nɛ a kɛ mumi ko loo munyu ko loo womi ko nɛ a ma de ke e je wa ngɔ ɔ nɛ puɛ nyɛ juɛmi kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Ligbi ɔ ba momo. 3Nyɛ ko ha nɔ ko nɛ e sisi nyɛ ngɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko nɔ, ejakaa ja Mawu jami kuami ɔ ba lolo, nɛ a je dikalɔ nɛ ji hɛ mi kpatami bi ɔ kpo, 4nɔ nɛ maa wo e he nɔ nɛ e maa te si ngɔ si nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ mawu loo mawu jami ɔ, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma ya hi Mawu we ɔ kaa mawu ko nɛ e ma tsɛ e he kaa lɛ ji Mawu ɔ.
5Nyɛ kai we kaa, benɛ i kɛ nyɛ̃ ngɛ ɔ, i de nyɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ lo? 6Nɛ jehanɛ ɔ, nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ e kpo jemi ɔ blɔ tsie ɔ. 7Ejakaa mlaa kuami laami sane ɔ ngɛ ni tsue momo; se ja a je nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ ngɛ blɔ tsie ɔ kɛ je blɔ mi lolo. 8Nɛ lɔ ɔ loko a ma je dikalɔ ɔ kpo paa, nɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu kɛ e nya mi mumi ɔ maa gbe lɛ, nɛ e kɛ e bami ɔ kpɛmi ɔ ma kpata e hɛ mi. 9Dikalɔ ɔ maa be kɛ Satan ni tsumi nɛ mi wa ngɛ lakpa he wami kɛ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi tsuo mi, 10kɛ nihi nɛ dɛ blɔ kulaa nɛ a kɛ mlɔɔ nihi nɛ laa amɛ, ejakaa a pɛtɛ we anɔkuale suɔmi ɔ he konɛ a kɛ he a yi wami. 11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Mawu maa tsɔ sisimi nɛ nya wa kɛ maa ba a ngɔ konɛ a he lakpa a nɛ a ye, 12konɛ a kojo nihi kulaa nɛ he we anɔkuale ɔ yi, se a naa nihi nɛ dɛ blɔ ɔmɛ mohu a he tsui ɔ.
A hla nyɛ ha yi wami hemi
13Se wɔɔ lɛɛ, e sa kaa wa naa Mawu si daa ngɛ nyɛ he, mamimɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ, ejakaa Mawu hla nyɛ kɛ je sisije ngɔ ha yi wami hemi ngɛ mumi ɔ klɔuklɔu peemi kɛ anɔkuale ɔ hemi kɛ yemi mi, 14enɛ ɔ he nɛ e gu wa sane kpakpa a nɔ tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba, konɛ nyɛ na wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo hɛ mi nyami ɔ. 15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ da si, nɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ nihi nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ munyu mi loo womi mi ɔmɛ a mi.
16Se lɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ nitsɛ, kɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu nɛ suɔ wɔ nɛ e kɛ neneene bua womi kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kpakpa ha wɔ ngɛ dloomi nya a, 17lɛ nɔuu e maa wo nyɛ bua, nɛ e maa wo nyɛ he wami ngɛ munyu kpakpa kɛ ni tsumi kpakpa tsuo mi.

english_text:
Pray for Us
1Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do. 2Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith. 3But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm. 4He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying. 5I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ.
Warnings against Laziness
6My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you. 7You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing, 8and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
9We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you. 10We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat. 11Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody. 12So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living. 13Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
14Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them. 15Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower.
Final Prayer
16I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
17I always sign my letters as I am now doing: PAUL.
18I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_text:
Nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ha wɔ
1Nyagbe ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ha wɔ, konɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ nɛ gbɛ fia kɛ fo kɛ ya nɔ, nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami, kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ hulɔ ɔ; 2nyɛ kpa pɛɛ nɛ a je wɔ kɛ je yi mi wali kɛ nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi, ejakaa pi nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi.
3Se anɔkualetsɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ maa wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ e maa bu nyɛ he kɛ maa je dikalɔ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ. 4Se wa hɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi kaa, nihi nɛ wa wo nyɛ he kita a, nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ nyɛ maa pee hulɔ.
5Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ plɛ nyɛ tsui kɛ ya Mawu suɔmi kɛ Kristo tsui si tomi ɔ he.
Bɔ nɛ e hia kaa a tsu ni
6Se, mamimɛ, wa ngɛ nyɛ fae ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi kaa nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛmi tsuaa nyɛmi nɛ tsu we ni nɛ nyɛɛ we ngɛ nihi nɛ wa tu ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ mi ɔ nya a ko bɔ. 7Ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa e sa kaa nyɛ kaseɔ wɔ; ejakaa wa pee we hejɔ benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, 8nɛ jehanɛ hu wa yi nɔ ko ku yaka, se mohu waa kɛ mɔde bɔmi kɛ pɔtɔ tsuɔ ni nyɔ kɛ pia, benɛ pee nɛ wa ko pee tlomi ngɔ ha nyɛ ti nɔ ko. 9Tsa pi kaa wa be jamɛ a he blɔ, se mohu, konɛ waa ngɔ wa he ngɔ pee nɔ hyemi nɔ ha nyɛ. 10Ejakaa benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ hu ɔ, wa wo nyɛ kita ke, ke nɔ ko sume kaa e tsuɔ ni ɔ, lɛɛ e ko ye ni hu mɔ.
11Ejakaa wa nuɔ kaa ni komɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ peɔ hejɔ nɛ a tsu we ni se mohu a ngɔɔ a nya ngɔ woɔ nihi a sanehi a mi. 12Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, wa ngɛ mɛ fae nɛ wa ngɛ mɛ ga woe ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo mi kaa a tsu ni kpoo nɛ a ye mɛ nitsɛmɛ a dɛ mi ngma.
13Mamimɛ, nyɛ ko ha pɔ nɛ tɔ nyɛ kɛ kpakpa peemi. 14Se ke nɔ ko bui wa munyu nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ tue ɔ, nyɛ kadi lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko bɔ, konɛ zo nɛ gbe lɛ. 15Nyɛ ko bu lɛ kaa henyɛlɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ kaa nyɛmi.
Nyagbe sɛyemi
16Lɛ he jɔmi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ nɛ ha nyɛ he jɔmi daa ngɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mi. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ kulaa nɛ hi si!
17Imi Paulo nitsɛ ye nine nya biɔmi nɛ ji okadi ngɛ ye womi tsuaa womi mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Bɔ nɛ i ngmaa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
18Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ kulaa nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_text:
1From Paul.
God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
2 Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace!
Warning against False Teaching
3When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings. 4You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
5You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith. 6There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk. 7They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
8We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way. 9We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents. 10The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching 11of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me.
Being Thankful for God's Kindness
12I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me. 13 I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him. 14Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
15“Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all! 16But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life. 17I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
18Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier. 19You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences. 20Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_text:
1Paulo nɛ ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo ngɛ Mawu, wa yi wami helɔ ɔ, kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo, wa hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ, kita nya a, 2ngma ya ha Timoteo nɛ ji e bi nitsɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ:
Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu kɛ Yesu Kristo, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, dɛ mi ɔ ha mo!
Tsɔɔmi yaya he kɔkɔbɔmi
3Kaa bɔ nɛ benɛ i yaa Makedonia nɛ i kpa mo pɛɛ ke o hi si ngɛ Efeso konɛ o bɔ ni komɛ kɔkɔ ke a ko tsɔɔ tsɔɔmi kpahi, 4nɛ jehanɛ hu a ko di nyaziahi kɛ weku sisi tsɔɔmi tslalaa se, ejakaa enɛ ɔmɛ kɛ nɔ jemi baa mohu pe Mawu blɔ nya tomi nɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ, jamɛ a pɛɛ ɔ i ngɛ mo kpae ekohu. 5Kita a nya gbemi ji suɔmi nɛ je tsui nɛ mi tsɔ kɛ he nile kpakpa kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ lakpa ko be mi ɔ mi, 6nihi nɛ ni komɛ je se, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho yaka munyu he ya. 7A ngɛ hlae nɛ a pee a he mlaa tsɔɔli, pohu a nɛ nihi nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ loo nihi nɛ a ngɛ nɔ mi mae tutuutu ɔmɛ a sisi.
8Wa le kaa mlaa a hi ha nɔ nɛ tsuɔ he ni bɔ nɛ sa mlaa, 9nɛ e le enɛ ɔ, kaa dalɔ ɔ a wui lɛ mlaa, se mohu mlaa nɔ tɔli kɛ tue gboli, mlaa a woɔ: nihi nɛ ja we Mawu kɛ yayami peeli, nihi nɛ hɛ mi be nyami kɛ he bleli, tsɛ gbeli kɛ nyɛ gbeli, awi yeli, 10ajuama bɔli, nyumuhi nɛ kɛ nyumuhi hwɔɔ si, nɔmlɔ juli, nya ngɔli, kita mi kuli kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ kɛ tsɔɔmi kpakpa yi ɔ, 11ngɛ Mawu nɛ a gbaa lɛ ɔ nyami sane kpakpa nɛ a tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ nya.
Mawu mɔbɔnami he sina
12I naa wa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ wo mi he wami ɔ si, kaa e bu mi anɔkualetsɛ nɛ e ngɔ mi ngɔ wo sɔmɔmi ɔ mi, 13imi nɛ kekle ɔ i ji musu bɔlɔ kɛ yi mi walɔ kɛ nɔ builɔ; se kɛ ɔ, a na mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa i li nɛ i pee, ngɛ hemi nɛ i he we yi ɔ he. 14Se wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ plɛ e dloomi nɛ hiɛ babauu kɛ be nɔ ɔ pue ye nɔ, nɛ e ha i hyi kɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ suɔmi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ. 15E ji anɔkuale munyu nɛ sa kaa a pɛtɛ he kulaa, kaa Kristo Yesu ba je nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e ba he yayami peeli a yi wami, nihi a kpɛti nɛ imi ji titima a; 16se kɛ ɔ, enɛ ɔ he nɛ a na mi mɔbɔ ɔ nɛ, konɛ imi kekle ye mi nɛ Kristo nɛ je e tsui si tomi ɔ kulaa kpo ngɛ, nɛ a kɛ to okadi ha nihi nɛ ma he e nɔ ngɔ ye, nɛ a na neneene wami. 17Neneene Matsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ gbo we, nɔ nɛ ji Mawu kake ɔ, a ngɔ bu kɛ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha lɛ kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene! Amen.
18Ye bi Timoteo, i ngɛ mo kita nɛ ɔ woe, ngɛ gbamihi nɛ a gba sa ngɛ o he ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ o kɛ hwu ta kpakpa a, 19nɛ o hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ he ni lemi kpakpa, nɔ́ nɛ ni komɛ sake fɔ he nɛ a kɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ya sa si ɔ; 20a ti ni komɛ ji Himeneo kɛ Aleksandro, nihi nɛ i tu ngɔ wo Satan dɛ mi, konɛ a gbla a tue nɛ a ko tu musu bɔmi munyuhi hu ɔ.

english_text:
How To Pray
1First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them. 2Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God. 3This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior. 4God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
5There is only one God,
and Christ Jesus
is the only one
who can bring us
to God.
Jesus was truly human,
and he gave himself
to rescue all of us.
6God showed us this
at the right time.
7 This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
8I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
9 I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls. 10Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others, 11and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention. 12They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do. 13 After all, Adam was created before Eve, 14 and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned. 15But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_text:
Asafo mi jami
1Kekleekle ɔ, nɔ nɛ i ngɛ he ga woe ji kaa a hɛɛ spɛɛ kpamihi, sɔlemihi, mi damihi, sinamihi a mi ha nimli kulaa, 2ngɔ ha matsɛmɛ kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya, konɛ waa hi si kpoo ngɛ he jɔmi mi, ngɛ Mawu jami kɛ je mi bami kpakpa nɛ sa mi. 3Ejakaa enɛ ɔ hi nɛ e ngɔɔ Mawu nɛ ji wa yi wami helɔ ɔ nya, 4nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e he nimli tsuo a yi wami, konɛ a le anɔkuale ɔ. 5Ejakaa Mawu kake lɛ ngɛ, kɛ Mawu kɛ nimli a mi dalɔ kake hu nɛ ji nɔmlɔ Kristo Yesu ɔ, 6nɔ nɛ ngɔ e he ngɔ ha kaa kpɔmi nɔ ha nimli tsuo, nɛ ji odase nɛ a yeɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi ɔ; 7enɛ ɔ he nɛ a wo mi fiɛlɔ kɛ bɔfo (anɔkuale i ngɛ tue ngɛ Kristo mi, i yi lakpa!), maje li a tsɔɔlɔ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ nɛ.
8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ hlae kaa nyumuhi nɛ a sɔle ngɛ he tsuaa he, nɛ a wo a ninehi nɛ he tsɔ nɔ nɛ mi mi fumi loo nya sami ko hi mi. 9Ja nɔuu yihi hu, a kɛ tade nɛ sa kɛ humipeemi kɛ juɛmi nɛ mi tsɔ nɛ dla a he, pi kɛ yi hɔɔmi slɔɔto ko loo sika loo adiagba loo tade nɛ he jua wa 10se mohu kɛ ni tsumi kpakpahi nɛ sa yihi nɛ tsɔɔ a he kaa Mawu jali ji mɛ ɔ. 11Yo nɛ pee kpoo nɛ e kase ni ngɛ tue bumi tsuo mi. 12I ngmɛ́ yo blɔ kaa e tsɔɔ ni aloo e ye nyumu nɔ, se mohu e pee kpoo. 13Ejakaa Adam kekle a bɔ, lɔ ɔ se ɔ Hawa. 14Nɛ pi Adam nɛ a sisi ɔ, se yo ɔ a sisi, nɛ e sɛ tɔmi mi. 15Se a ma he e yi wami kɛ maa gu bimɛ a fɔmi mi, ke a hi si ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ suɔmi kɛ he tsɔmi kɛ juɛmi hu nɛ sa mi ɔ.

english_text:
Church Officials
1It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile. 2 That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach. 3They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
4Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful. 5If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
6They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil. 7Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil.
Church Officers
8Church officers should be serious. They must not be liars, heavy drinkers, or greedy for money. 9And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith. 10They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
11Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
12Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home. 13Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus.
The Mystery of Our Religion
14I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions, 15so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
16Here is the great mystery of our religion:
Christ came as a human.
The Spirit proved
that he pleased God,
and he was seen by angels.
Christ was preached
to the nations.
People in this world
put their faith in him,
and he was taken up to glory.
translation_text:
Asafo nɔ hyɛli
1Anɔkuale munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke nɔ ko ngɛ nɔ hyɛmi ni tsumi hlae ɔ, e ngɛ ni tsumi kpakpa hlae.” 2Se e sa kaa nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ hi si bɔ nɛ a be e he sane ko nae, nɔ nɛ ngɛ yo kake, hɛ si kalɔ, nɔ nɛ juɛmi mi tsɔ, nɔ nɛ baa e je mi saminya, nibwɔ peelɔ, nɔ nɛ le ni tsɔɔmi; 3pi da delɔ, pi nine kpokpookpo tsɛ, se mohu nɔ nɛ he jɔ, nɔ nɛ pɛ́, nɔ nɛ hɛ kɔɛ sika nɔ; 4nɔ nɛ yeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e we nɔ saminya, nɛ e bimɛ buɔ lɛ tue nɛ a buu lɛ. 5Se ke nɔ ko li lɛ nitsɛ e we nɔ hyɛmi ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛ hyɛ Mawu asafo ɔ nɔ kɛɛ? 6Jehanɛ pi nɔ nɛ sɛ Mawu jami mi kɛ we, konɛ e ko wo e he nɔ nɛ e nɔ abosiami kojomi mi. 7E sa kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ se ɔ hu a ye e he odase kpakpa, konɛ e ko na biɛ yaya nɛ e sɛ abosiami klama mi.
Asafo mi sɔmɔli a hepiɛli
8Asafo mi sɔmɔli ɔmɛ hu, e sa kaa a pee nimli nɛ a hɛ mi jiɔ, pi nya enyɔenyɔtsɛmɛ, pi da deli, pi hɛ tsuli, 9se nihi nɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ laami sane ɔ ngɛ he nile nɛ he tsɔ mi. 10Se ni nɛ ɔmɛ hu a ka mɛ nɛ a hyɛ lolo; lɔ ɔ se ke sane ko be a he ɔ, a sɔmɔ. 11Yi ɔmɛ hu ja nɔuu; a pee nihi nɛ a hɛ mi jiɔ, pi sieku yeli, se a hɛ nɛ ka si, a ye anɔkuale ngɛ́ nihi kulaa mi. 12Asafo mi sɔmɔli ɔmɛ nɛ pee yo kakaakatsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ yeɔ a bimɛ kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nihi a nɔ saminya. 13Ejakaa ninɛmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ saminya a, a naa bu, kɛ kã babauu ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ mi.
Laami sane ngua a
14I ngɛ mo enɛ ɔmɛ ngmae, nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa e be kɛe nɛ ma ba o ngɔ. 15Se ke ye se ya kɛ ɔ nɛ o le bɔ nɛ sa nɛ nihi nɛ a ba je mi ha ngɛ Mawu we, nɛ ji Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ asafo ɔ anɔkuale ɔ titima kɛ e sepimi nɔ́ ɔ mi. 16Nɔ jemi be he kaa Mawu jami laami sane ɔ, e mi kuɔ.
Mawu je e he si paa ngɛ he lo mi,
E ye nguɔ ngɛ mumi mi,
E je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ bɔfohi,
A fiɛ lɛ ngɛ majeli a kpɛti,
A he e nɔ ye ngɛ je mi,
A ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ngɛ nyami mi.

english_text:
People Will Turn from Their Faith
1God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons. 2They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars 3will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth. 4Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything. 5What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat.
Paul's Advice to Timothy
6If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed. 7Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious. 8-9As the saying goes,
“Exercise is good
for your body,
but religion helps you
in every way.
It promises life
now and forever.”
These words are worthwhile and should not be forgotten. 10We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
11Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say. 12Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
13Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching. 14Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you. 15Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing. 16Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_text:
Lakpa tsɔɔli
1Mumi ɔ deɔ paa ke, nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, ni komɛ ma kua hemi kɛ yemi ɔ, nɛ a ma ya nyɛɛ sisimi mumihi kɛ mumi yayamihi a tsɔɔmihi a se, 2ngɛ nya ngɔli a sato peemi mi, nihi nɛ a he nile gbo kaa nɔ nɛ a sã kɛ dade kɛ la, 3nɛ a tsiɔ yo ngɔmi blɔ, nɛ a deɔ ke a nyɛ ngma nɛ Mawu bɔ kaa nihi nɛ heɔ yeɔ nɛ le anɔkuale ɔ kɛ sina nɛ ye ɔ. 4Ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu bɔ ɔ e hi, nɛ a nyɛ́ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ sina yeɔ ɔ, 5ejakaa a kɛ Mawu munyu kɛ sɔlemi tsukɔɔ he.
Kristo Yesu sɔmɔlɔ kpakpa
6Ke o tsɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ enɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, o maa pee o he Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ kpakpa, nɔ nɛ lɛɛ e he kɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ tsɔɔmi kpakpa nɛ o nyɛɛ se ɔ. 7Se yimowi a yakayaka nyazia amɛ ɔ guu. Bɔɔ Mawu jami mohu he mɔde. 8Ejakaa nɔmlɔ tso he mɔde bɔmi he se nami pi, se Mawu jami he ngɛ se nami ngɛ nihi tsuo kulaa mi, nɛ e ngɛ wami nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ maa ba a he si womi. 9Enɛ ɔ ji anɔkuale munyu nɛ sa kaa a pɛtɛ he saminya. 10Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ wa gboɔ dengme nɛ wa haa a jɛɛ wɔ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɔ, nɔ nɛ ji nimli kulaa a yi wami helɔ, titli ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ.
11Wo ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he kita nɛ o tsɔɔ. 12Ko ha nɔ ko nɛ gbe o he guɛ ngɛ niheyo nɛ o ji ɔ he, se mohu o kɛ o he nɛ pee nɔ hyemi nɔ ngɔ ha ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, ngɛ munyu tutui mi, ngɛ jemi bami mi, ngɛ suɔmi mi, ngɛ mumi, mi ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi, ngɛ he tsɔmi mi. 13Hii womi kanee kɛ ga womi kɛ ni tsɔɔmi kɛ ya su be nɛ ma ba. 14Koo ngmɛɛ o dloomi ke nɔ nɛ a ngɔ ha mo kɛ gu gbami kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ninehi nɛ a kɛ pue o nɔ ɔ he. 15Mo gbo ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he dengme, o kɛ ohe nɛ wo mi kulaa, konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ na o nɔ yami paa. 16O hɛ nɛ hi o he nɔ kɛ o tsɔɔmi ɔ, hii si ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a mi; ejakaa ke o pee enɛ ɔ ɔ, o ma he mo nitsɛ kɛ nihi nɛ buɔ mo tue ɔ kulaa yi wami.

english_text:
How To Act toward Others
1Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother, 2and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
3Take care of any widow who is really in need. 4But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do. 5 A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
6A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
7Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing. 8People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
9For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least 60 years old, and she must have been faithful in marriage. 10She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
11Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ 12and become guilty of breaking their promise to him. 13Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
14I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us. 15Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
16If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need.
Church Leaders
17Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching. 18 It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
19 Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges. 20But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
21In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
22Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them.
Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
23Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
24Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later. 25It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_text:
Asafo nɔhyɛmi
1Koo tu nɔkɔtɔma ko hɛ mi munyu wawɛɛ, se mohu o tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ kaa o tsɛ; nihewi hu kaa nyɛmimɛ; 2yi nikɔtɔma amɛ kaa nyɛmɛ; yihewi ɔmɛ hu kaa nyɛmimɛ yihi ngɛ he tsɔmi tsuo mi.
3Yalɔyi nitsɛnitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, buu mɛ. 4Ke yalɔyo ko ngɛ bimɛ loo bibimɛ ɔ, a kase Mawu gbeye yemi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a we mi kekle, nɛ a to a fɔli ɔmɛ nane mi pɛpɛɛpɛ, ejakaa enɛ ɔ ngɛ fɛu nɛ e sa Mawu hɛ mi. 5Nɔ nɛ ji yalɔyo niinɛ nɛ e piɛ e nɔ kake too ɔ, ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Mawu nɔ, nɛ e hɛɛ pɛɛ kpami kɛ sɔlemi mi nyɔ kɛ pia. 6Se yo nɛ fiɛɛ nyumu fiɛmi ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ mohu se e gbo. 7Wo mɛ mlaa ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ a he konɛ a ko na a he munyu ko nɛ a tu. 8Ke nɔ ko hyɛ we lɛ nitsɛ e nihi, titli ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e we mi bimɛ ɔ, e kpa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ se, nɛ afani nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ ngɛ e he.
9Koo ngɔ yalɔyo nɛ na we nɛ e ye jeha nyingmi ekpa ngɔ wo sɔmɔmi ɔ mi, ja nɔ nɛ gba nyumu kake, 10nɔ nɛ a tuɔ e he munyu kpakpa kaa e tsu ni kpakpahi, lɔ ɔ ji: ke e lɛ bimɛ, ke e pee nihi nibwɔ, ke e fɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nane he, ke e ye bua nihi nɛ naa amanehlu ɔ, ke e di ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa nitsumi kpakpa se ɔ.
11Se yalɔyi nɛ wɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, koo ngɔ mɛ, ejakaa ke nyumu sumi sɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, a jee Kristo se ya hlaa gba; 12nɛ a naa kojomi ejakaa a ngmɛɛ a kekle hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he. 13Nɛ enɛ ɔ se ɔ a kaseɔ hejɔ peemi kɛ si pomi ngɛ wehi a mi, nɛ pi hejɔ kɛkɛ nɛ a peɔ, se a peɔ a he sieku yeli, kɛ si jeli nɛ tuɔ munyu nɛ sɛ. 14Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i suɔ kaa yalɔyihi nɛ wɛ́ lolo ɔ a gba, nɛ a fɔ bimɛ, nɛ a ye a we nɔ, nɛ a ko ha he nyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ na sane ko nɛ e kɛ jɛ wɔ; 15ejakaa ni komɛ kpale ya nyɛɛ Satan se momo. 16Se ke nyumu lo yo nɛ heɔ yeɔ ngɛ yalɔyihi ɔ, e hyɛ mɛ nɛ e ko pee tlomi kɛ ha asafo ɔ, konɛ asafo ɔ nɛ hyɛ yalɔyihi nitsɛnitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
17Nikɔtɔmahi nɛ tsuɔ a ni saminya a, e sa kaa a ngɔ bu totoe enyɔ ngɔ ha mɛ, titli ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ bɔɔ munyu tumi kɛ tsɔɔmi he mɔde ɔ. 18Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke:
“Koo wo na nɛ gblɛɔ blɛfo ɔ nya kotoku;”
kɛ: “Nitsulɔ ɔ, e hiɔwo sa lɛ.”
19Ke a po nɔkɔtɔma ko nya a, ko he kplɛɛ kaa ja ngɛ odasefohi enyɔ loo etɛ nya lolo. 20Ninɛmɛ nɛ peɔ yayami ɔ, ka mɛ ngɛ nihi kulaa a hɛ mi, konɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ hu nɛ ye gbeye.
21I ngɛ mo mlaa woe ngɛ Mawu kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo kɛ e bɔfohi nɛ e hia amɛ a hɛ mi, kaa o ye ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ o ko hyɛ nihi a hɛ mi kɛ kojo, nɛ jehanɛ hu, o ko hia nɔ mi. 22Koo ngɔ po nine ngɔ pue nɔ ko nɔ oya, nɛ jehanɛ hu, koo ngɔ o he ngɔ futu ni kpahi a he yayamihi a mi. To o he nyaii.
23Koo nu nyu sɔuu, se nuu wai bɔɔ ngɛ o muklii kɛ o hiɔhi nɛ nuu mo kpitikpiti ɔmɛ a he.
24Ni komɛ a he yayamihi jee kpo paa mla, nɛ a sɛɛ a hlami kɛ yaa kojomi mi, se ni komɛ a nɔ hu kpɛɛ se. 25Ja nɔuu ni tsumi kpakpahi hu jee kpo paa, nɛ nihi nɛ ji kpo paa a hu a be nyɛe nɛ a kɛ maa laa.

english_text:
1If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching. 2If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can.
False Teaching and True Wealth
These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do. 3Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ. 4Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions, 5and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth.
These people think religion is supposed to make you rich. 6And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have. 7We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave. 8So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes. 9People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them. 10The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain.
Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
11Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle. 12Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened. 13 Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith. 14Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
15 The glorious God
is the only Ruler,
the King of kings
and Lord of lords.
At the time that God
has already decided,
he will send Jesus Christ
back again.
16 Only God lives forever!
And he lives in light
that no one can come near.
No human has ever seen God
or ever can see him.
God will be honored,
and his power
will last forever. Amen.
17Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life. 18Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have. 19This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
20Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't. 21Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk.
I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_text:
Lakpa tsɔɔmi
1Sɔmɔli tsuo nɛ ngɛ nyɔguɛ yemi mi ɔ, a bu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kaa nihi nɛ bu tsuo sa mɛ, konɛ a ko tu Mawu biɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ he musu bɔmi munyu. 2Se nyɔguɛhi nɛ ngɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ nɛ he ye ɔ, a ko gbe a he guɛ, se mohu a sɔmɔ mɛ saminya akɛnɛ nyɛmimɛ ji mɛ he je ɔ, ejakaa ninɛmɛ nɛ naa ni tsumi ɔ mi nihi ɔ, nihi nɛ he ye kɛ suɔli ʼi. Tsɔɔ mɛ enɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o wo mɛ ga ngɛ he.
Lakpa tsɔɔmi kɛ ninami nitsɛ
3Ke nɔ ko tsɔɔ tsɔɔmi kpa ko, nɛ e ngɔɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo munyuhi nɛ tsaa nɔ ɔ kɛ Mawu jami nya tsɔɔmi ɔ, 4lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e wo e he nɔ, nɛ e li nɔ ko, se mohu e ngɛ gboe kɛ nɔ jemi kɛ nya sami nɛ hɛkɔ, pɛ, musu bɔmi munyuhi, nihi a he susumi yaya jee mi ɔ, 5nɛ ji yakayaka ngmlaa kpami nɛ nimli nɛ a juɛmi puɛ nɛ a kpɔ anɔkuale ɔ ngɛ a dɛ nɛ a susuɔ kaa Mawu jami ji ni nami ɔ.
6Se niinɛ, ni nami agbo ji Mawu jami, ke nɔ ko bua jɔ e nihi a he ɔ. 7Ejakaa waa kɛ nɔ ko nɔ́ ko bɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ e fɔɔ si paa kaa wa be nyɛe waa kɛ nɔ ko maa ya hulɔ. 8Se ke wa ngɛ ngma kɛ he hami nihi kɛkɛ ɔ, e sa kaa wa bua nɛ jɔ he. 9Nihi nɛ hlaa nɛ a na ni fuu ɔ, nɔɔ ka kɛ klama kɛ kuasiahi akɔnɔhi fuu nɛ puɛɔ nɔ nɛ tsɛɛ nihi ngɔ woɔ hɛ mi kpatami kɛ laami mi ɔ mi. 10Ejakaa ni yayahi kulaa sipoku ji sika suɔmi nɛ ni komɛ di se nɛ a tla blɔ kɛ je hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, nɛ a kɛ piimi babauu gbɔ a tsui mi ɔ.
Nitsɔɔmi kɛ ha Timoteo nitsɛ
11Se moo lɛɛ, oo Mawu nɔmlɔ, tuu ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nya fo, nɛ o nyɛɛ dami, Mawu jami, hemi kɛ yemi, suɔmi, tsui sitomi kɛ mi mi jɔmi se. 12Hwu hemi kɛ yemi ta kpakpa a, pɛtɛ neneene wami ɔ he, nɔ́ he hulɔ nɛ a tsɛ mo kɛ ba benɛ o jaje jajemi kpakpa ngɛ odasefohi fuu a hɛ mi, ɔ. 13I ngɛ mo kita woe ngɛ Mawu nɛ haa nihi tsuo kulaa wami ɔ kɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ ye jajemi kpakpa a he odase ngɛ Pontio Pilato yi nɔ ɔ hɛ mi, 14kaa o ye kita a nɔ, nɛ kpa ko loo piami ko ko hi he kɛ yaa su wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo bami ɔ mi. 15Nɔ nɛ hewami nɔyelɔ kake nɛ da gbaa, matsɛmɛ a matsɛ, kɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa je kpo ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e be mi ɔ; 16nɔ nɛ lɛ e nɔ kake lɛ ngɛ neneene si himi nɛ gbenɔ be mi, nɛ e hii la nɛ a be nyɛemaa su he ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ ko nɔmlɔ ko nɛ́ lɛ hyɛ, nɛ e be lɛ nyɛe maa na hulɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji neneene bu kɛ he wami ɔ. Amen.
17Niatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, wo mɛ kita konɛ a ko susu ni nguahi, nɛ a ko ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ ni nami nɛ be sɔkee ɔ nɔ, se mohu Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ haa wɔ babauu ke waa ye mi ngɔmi ɔ. 18A pee kpakpa, nɛ a plɛ niatsɛmɛ ngɛ kpakpa peemi blɔfami, a suɔ nɔ hami, a ko pee kpɛle, 19a to juetli ngɔ ha a he, nɛ e pee sisi tomi kpakpa ha be nɛ maa ba a, konɛ a pɛtɛ anɔkuale wami ɔ he.
20Oo Timoteo! nihi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo o dɛ mi ɔ baa yi, nɛ o kua yakayaka ni sɛɛmi nɛ bleɔ nɔ kɛ nɔ jemi munyu nɛ je lakpa ni lemi mi ɔ, 21nɔ́ nɛ ni komɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ngɛ nɛ a tla blɔ kɛ je hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he ɔ.
Dloomi ɔ kɛ mo nɛ hi si! Amen.

english_text:
1From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus.
God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
2 Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace!
Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
3Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience. 4I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy. 5 I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well. 6So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well. 7God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
8Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
9God saved us and chose us
to be his holy people.
We did nothing
to deserve this,
but God planned it
because he is so kind.
Even before time began
God planned for Christ Jesus
to show kindness to us.
10Now Christ Jesus has come
to offer us God's gift
of undeserved grace.
Christ our Savior defeated death
and brought us
the good news.
It shines like a light
and offers life
that never ends.
11 My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher. 12This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with. 13Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model. 14You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
15You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
16I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail. 17Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me. 18I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_text:
1Paulo nɛ ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya kɛ wami nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ he si womi nya a, 2ngma ya ha e suɔmi bi Timoteo ɔ: Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo Yesu dɛ mi ɔ ha mo!
Sinami kɛ he wami womi
3I naa Mawu nɛ i kɛ ye nimeli jaa ngɛ he nile klɔuu mi ɔ si, kaa i jɔɔ we mo kaimi gblee ngɛ ye pɛɛ kpamihi a mi nyɔ kɛ pia, 4nɛ ke i kai o hɛ mi vo nyu ɔ, i hlaa kaa ma na mo, konɛ ye bua nɛ jɔ. 5Ye hɛ ngɛ o hemi kɛ yemi nɛ lakpa be mi ɔ nɔ, nɔ́ nɛ kekle nɛ e ngɛ o na Loise kɛ o nyɛ Eunike mi, nɛ i ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ kaa e ngɛ mo hu o mi ɔ. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ mo kaie kaa, Mawu dloomi ke nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ o mi ngɛ ye nine nɛ i kɛ pue o nɔ ɔ nya a, tle lɛ si nɛ e tso, 7ejakaa Mawu hi wɔ gbeye yemi mumi, se mohu he wami kɛ suɔmi kɛ juɛmi nɛ sa mumi ekɛ ha wɔ.
8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, zo ko pee mo ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he odase yemi ɔ he aloo ngɛ imi nɛ i ji e pa mi no ɔ he, se mohu o kɛ mi gbo dengme ngɛ sane kpakpa a he ngɛ Mawu he wami nya. 9Nɔ nɛ he wa yi wami nɛ e kɛ tsɛmi klɔuklɔu tsɛ wɔ, pi ngɛ wa ni tsumihi a nya, se mohu ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi tomi kɛ e dloomi nya, nɔ́ nɛ e ngɔ ha wɔ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi loko a bɔ je ɔ, 10nɛ jehanɛ a gu wa yi wami helɔ Yesu Kristo he kpo jemi ɔ nɔ je lɛ si paa a; nɔ nɛ po gbenɔ se nɛ e je wami kɛ neneene si himi kpo tsɔɔ wɔ ngɛ sane kpakpa a mi, 11nɔ́ he nɛ a wo mi fiɛlɔ kɛ bɔfo kɛ maje li ɔmɛ a tsɔɔlɔ ɔ, 12kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu he nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ nae nɔ nɛ. Se kɛ ɔ, e pee we mi zo, ejakaa i le nɔ nɛ i he ye ɔ, nɛ i ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ kaa e ma nyɛ nihi nɛ e to ha mi ɔmɛ a he maa bu kɛ ya si jamɛ a Ligbi ɔ nɔ. 13Pɛtɛ tsami munyu nɛ o nu kɛ je ye nya a nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ɔ he ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ suɔmi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ mi. 14Ni kpakpahi nɛ a tu wo o dɛ ɔ buu he ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɛ hii wa mi ɔ he wami nya!
15O le enɛ kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ Asia a tsuo kpa ngɛ ye se, a ti ni komɛ ji Fegelo kɛ Hermogene. 16Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ na Onesiforo we ɔ mɔbɔ, ejakaa e baa kpitikpiti, ba haa mi tsui, nɛ zo pee we lɛ ngɛ ye tsu mi womi ɔ he; 17se benɛ e ba Roma a e bɔ mɔde ba hla mi nɛ e na mi. 18Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ha e na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi mɔbɔnami ngɛ jamɛ a Ligbi ɔ nɔ. Nɛ bɔ nɛ e plɛ kɛ sɔmɔ mi ngɛ Efeso ɔ, o le pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_text:
A Good Soldier of Christ Jesus
1Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace. 2You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
3As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering. 4Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer. 5No one wins an athletic contest without obeying the rules. 6And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field. 7If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
8Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says. 9And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail, 10and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus. 11Here is a true message:
“If we died with Christ,
we will live with him.
12 If we don't give up,
we will rule with him.
If we deny
that we know him,
he will deny
that he knows us.
13If we are not faithful,
he will still be faithful.
Christ cannot deny
who he is.”
An Approved Worker
14Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them. 15Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
16Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God. 17That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way 18by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
19But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
20In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not. 21This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
22Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure. 23Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble, 24and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
25Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth. 26They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_text:
Kristo Yesu ta bulɔ anɔkualetsɛ
