90O we anɔkuale yemi maa gblee yi nɔhi tsuo a mi.
Mo lɛ o ngɔ zugba a kɛ ma si
nɛ e maa si kpɛii nɛ ɔ nɛ.
91Níhi tsuo ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o fa mɛ ɔ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ,
ejakaa o tsɔli ji mɛ tsuo.
92Ke pi o mlaa a nɛ haa mi bua jɔmi ɔ,
jinɛ ye hɛ mi kpata momo
ngɛ ye amanehlu ɔ mi.
93Ye hɛ be o mlaa amɛ a nɔ jee gblegbleegble,
ejakaa a nɔ o gu kɛ he ye yi wami.
94O nɔ́ ji mi, he ye yi wami;
ejakaa i bɔ mɔde kaa ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
95Yiwutsosɛmɛ woɔ mi ka
nɛ a kpata ye hɛ mi;
se imi lɛɛ o mlaa amɛ a he mohu i susuɔ.
96I na le kaa sé ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he,
se o mlaa a lɛɛ tɔmi ko kulaa be he.
I suɔ Yawɛ mlaa a
97I suɔ o mlaa a kaa nɔ́ ko!
Ke je na kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e he pɛ i susuɔ.
98I le ní pe ye he nyɛli tsuo,
ejakaa o mlaa a kɛ mi ngɛ daa.
99I nuɔ nɔ́ sisi pe ye tsɔɔli ɔmɛ tsuo,
ejakaa o mlaa amɛ a he i susuɔ.
100I kɔɔ munyu se pe nikɔtɔmahi po;
ejakaa i yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
101I kpa je mi bami yayami ɔmɛ tsuo;
ejakaa i suɔ kaa ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
102I ji o munyu ɔmɛ a he;
ejakaa mo lɛ o tsɔɔ mi ní.
103O mlaa a ngɔɔ loo!
E ngɔɔ pe hwo tete po.
104O mlaa a jeɔ nile ha mi,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i hiee je mi bami yaya.
Yawɛ mlaa a ji la
105O munyu ɔ ji kane nɛ i kɛ hyɛɔ ye nane nya;
o munyu ɔ ji la nɛ haa ye blɔ mi tɛ̃ɔ.
106O mlaa amɛ da saminya,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i ngɛ mo si woe veveeve
ke ma ye a nɔ sisiisi.
107Yawɛ, mo he ye yi wami
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ,
se ye we amanehlu ɔ nya wa nitsɛnitsɛ.
108Yawɛ, mo he ye bɔ nɛ i kɛ ngɛ mo si nae ɔ,
nɛ o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.
109I dla ye he kɛ to ha gbenɔ be tsuaa be,
se kɛ̃ ɔ, i je we ye hɛ kɛ ji o mlaa a he.
110Yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsɔɔ mi klama mohu,
se i tɔ̃ we o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
111O mlaa amɛ ji ye weto ní kɛ yaa neneene.
O mlaa amɛ haa ye tsui nɔɔ ye mi fuaa.
112I to ye yi mi kaa ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ daa;
ma ye a nɔ kɛ yaa si ye gbenɔ ligbi.
Yawɛ mlaa a baa nɔ yi
113Nihi nɛ suɔ mo fa kɛ fa a, i sume mɛ;
i suɔ o mlaa amɛ mohu.
114Mo ji ye he bulɔ, kɛ ye yi baalɔ;
i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o siwo ɔ nɔ.
115Nyɛ yayami peeli, nyɛɛ je ye nɔ kɛ ya se!
Ye Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ a nɔ ma ye.
116Wo mi he wami
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo mi si ɔ;
ha nɛ ye yi nɛ na wami.
I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ kulaa;
koo gbe mi zo.
117Pɛtɛ ye he, konɛ ye yi nɛ na wami,
nɛ ye hɛ maa hi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ daa.
118Nihi tsuo nɛ yi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ,
niinɛ, o bui a he akɔtaa;
ga yayahi nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ peeɔ yaka.
119Yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ je mi ɔ,
o buu mɛ kaa kuku nɔ dade.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o mlaa amɛ pɛ lɛ i suɔ.
120O he sawale nu mi,
nɛ ye he ngɛ doe blibliibli;
ejakaa o kojomi ɔmɛ ngɛ gbeye.
Bu Yawɛ mlaa a tue
121Nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa lɛ i peeɔ,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo ngmɛɛ ye he
ha nihi nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae ɔ.
122Moo da mi ha o tsɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ e hi ha lɛ.
Ko ha nɛ he nɔ woli nɛ wa mi yi mi.
123I hyɛ blɔ hluu kaa o ma ba he ye yi wami,
kaa o maa ye o siwo ɔ nɔ;
se jehanɛ ye hɛ se gbo.
124Mo nɛ o suɔmi be nyagbe,
naa imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ mɔbɔ,
nɛ o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.
125O tsɔlɔ ji mi, ha mi nile,
konɛ ma nu o mlaa amɛ a sisi.
126Yawɛ, nihi ngɛ o mlaa a tɔ̃e;
be su nɛ o maa pee he nɔ́ ko.
127Imi lɛɛ i suɔ o mlaa amɛ pe sika tsu,
ee, pe sika tsu ngmingmiingmi.
128Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i buɔ o mlaa amɛ tsuo,
se blɔhi nɛ dɛ ɔ lɛɛ i sume.
Ye Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ
129O mlaa amɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yeɔ a nɔ kɛ ye tsui tsuo.
130Ke a tsɔɔ o mlaa a sisi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa la,
nɛ e haa kuasia po leɔ ní.
131I paa ye nya mi hatoo
kaa nɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ lɛ jloe
kɛ hyɛɛ o mlaa amɛ blɔ.
132Mo plɛ nɛ o hyɛ mi nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ o peeɔ kɛ haa nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ mo ɔ.
133Moo ye o siwo ɔ nɔ;
ko ha nɛ ma nɔ si;
ko ha nɛ yayami nɛ ye ye nɔ.
134Mo kpɔ mi kɛ je nihi nɛ waa mi yi mi ɔ a dɛ mi,
konɛ ma ye o mlaa a nɔ.
135Mo je o he si, nɛ o na imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ mɔbɔ,
nɛ o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.
136Ye hɛngmɛ tslaa nyu babaaba
kaa pa nɛ ngɛ bee,
ejakaa nimli adesahi yi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Yawɛ mlaa a da
137Yawɛ, dalɔ ji mo,
nɛ o mlaa amɛ hu da pɛpɛɛpɛ!
138Mlaa amɛ nɛ o wo ɔ, a da,
anɔkuale sɔuu.
139Ye mi mi ngɛ mi sããe kaa la,
ejakaa ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ bui o mlaa amɛ.
140Ke o wo si ɔ, o yeɔ nɔ sisiisi;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, i suɔ o siwo ɔ tsɔ!
141Imi lɛɛ nɔ wayoo nɛ a bui ha nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ji mi,
se ye hɛ ji o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
142Dalɔ ji mo, nɛ ja o ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene;
o mlaa a, anɔkuale sɔuu.
143Ke i ngɛ haomi mi, nɛ i ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ɔ,
o mlaa amɛ lɛɛ a haa nɛ ye bua jɔɔ saminya.
144O mlaa amɛ da kɛ yaa neneene.
Ha mi juɛmi nɛ kɔɔ nɔ́ se,
bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye yi nɛ na wami.
Ba he ye yi wami
145I ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ ngɛ mo tsɛe kɛ ye tsui tsuo.
Yawɛ, mo ha nɛ ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
146Mo i ngɛ tsɛe ɔ nɛ;
mo he ye yi wami,
nɛ ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
147I teɔ si makɛ mla,
nɛ i kpaa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛɔ mo ke o ba piɛ ye he.
I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o siwo ɔ nɔ.
148Nyɔ mi tsuo i hwɔ we mahe;
o siwo ɔ he i hii susue.
149Bu ye gbi tue koo;
ejakaa o suɔmi ɔ be nyagbe.
Yawɛ, moo lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ o peeɔ;
naa mi mɔbɔ, nɛ o baa ye yi.
150Nihi nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae
nɛ bui o mlaa a,
a ngɛ hɛe kɛ ngɛ ye he sue.
151Se Yawɛ, o ngɛ ye kasa nya haa,
nɛ o mlaa amɛ tsuo maa si kpɛii.
152I le kɛ je blema lokoo
kaa o wo mlaa amɛ nɛ a hi si kɛ ya neneene.
Ba piɛ ye he
153Hyɛ amanehlu nɛ i ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ,
nɛ o ba je mi kɛ je mi,
ejakaa ye hɛ ji o mlaa a nɔ.
154Ba ye ye sane ɔ ha mi, nɛ o kpɔ mi.
He ye yi wami
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.
155A be yiwutsotsɛmɛ a yi wami hee;
ejakaa a bui o mlaa amɛ.
156Se Yawɛ, mo nɛ o naa mɔbɔ babauu,
nɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da;
mo he ye yi wami.
157Nihi nɛ waa mi yi mi, kɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ
a he hiɛ babauu,
se kɛ̃ ɔ, ye hɛ ji o mlaa a nɔ.
158Ke i na nihi nɛ yi mo anɔkuale kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
a he peeɔ mi tãi;
ejakaa a yi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
159Yawɛ, i suɔ o mlaa amɛ kaa nɔ́ ko!
O suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he ɔ,
mo he ye yi wami.
160O munyu ɔ tsuo, anɔkuale sisiisi;
o mlaa amɛ da, nɛ eko tsuaa eko maa si
kpɛii kɛ yaa neneene.
I suɔ Yawɛ mlaa a kɛ ye tsui tsuo
161Ganɔhi waa mi yi mi yaka,
se kɛ̃ ɔ, i buɔ o mlaa amɛ.
162O munyu ɔ ngɔɔ ye nya.
Ye bua jɔɔ kaa nɔ ko nɛ e nine ya su
ta yibu ní nɛ he jua wa nɔ.
163I sume lakpa kulaa, i hiee lɛ;
se o mlaa lɛɛ i suɔ.
164I jeɔ o yi si kpaago daa ligbi,
ejakaa o mlaa amɛ da.
165Nihi nɛ suɔ o mlaa amɛ ɔ, a naa he jɔmi nitsɛnitsɛ,
nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be hae nɛ a maa tla blɔ.
166Yawɛ, mo o nɔ ye hɛ ngɛ,
ba he ye yi wami;
i peeɔ níhi nɛ o mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ.
167I yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ;
i suɔ o mlaa amɛ kɛ ye tsui tsuo.
168I yeɔ o mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ tsuo
a nɔ; o le ye yami kɛ bami mi fitsofitso.
Ba piɛ ye he
169Yawɛ, ngmlaa nɛ i ngɛ kpae kɛ ngɛ mo tsɛe ɔ,
bu tue koo!
Ha nɛ ma nu nɔ́ sisi
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ!
170Moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue
nɛ o ba kpɔ mi
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ!
171Ma je o yi daa;
ejakaa o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.
172Ma la o mlaa a he la;
ejakaa o mlaa amɛ tsuo da saminya.
173Pee klaalo nɛ o ba piɛ ye he;
ejakaa i yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
174Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo blɔ hyɛe;
ba he ye yi wami koo!
O mlaa a pɛ lɛ haa ye bua jɔɔ ye he.
175Ha nɛ ye yi nɛ na wami,
konɛ ma je o yi;
ha nɛ o mlaa amɛ nɛ a tsɔɔ mi blɔ.
176I ngɛ lalaalo woe kaa to nɛ laa;
mo hla imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ koo!
Ejakaa i je we ye hɛ ngɛ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1When I am in trouble, I pray,
2“Come and save me, Lord,
from deceitful liars!”
3What punishment is fitting
for you deceitful liars?
4Your reward should be
sharp and flaming arrows!
5But I must live as a foreigner
among the people of Meshech
and in the tents of Kedar.
6I have spent too much time
living among people
who hate peace.
7I am in favor of peace,
but when I speak of it,
all they want is war.
translation_text:
Ba piɛ ye he
1Benɛ i ngɛ haomi mi ɔ,
i kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ
e bu mi tue.
2Yawɛ, je mi kɛ je lakpatsɛmɛ,
nihi nɛ sisiɔ a sibi a dɛ mi.
3Nyɛ lakpatsɛmɛ, mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae
nɛ a ha nyɛ?
Mɛni po nɛ nyɛ pa ngɛ hlae
nɛ a pee ha nyɛ?
4Nyɛ hɛɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi nɛ a nya ba,
kɛ la ngu hɛuu kɛ ma
kaa ta buli.
5Ye yi fi pɛ!
Hyɛ kaa i ba to nubwɔ ngɛ Meshek;
nɛ i ngɛ Kedar bi a ma mi!
6Ye se ba kɛ tsɔ ngɛ
nihi nɛ sume tue mi jɔmi ɔ a kpɛti.
7Imi lɛɛ he jɔmi nɔmlɔ ji mi,
se ke i tu munyu kɛkɛ
mɛɛ lɛɛ a hia ta!

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Will Protect His People
1I look to the hills!
Where will I find help?
2It will come from the Lord,
who created heaven and earth.
3The Lord is your protector,
and he won't go to sleep
or let you stumble.
4The protector of Israel
doesn't doze
or ever get drowsy.
5The Lord is your protector,
there at your right side
to shade you from the sun.
6You won't be harmed
by the sun during the day
or by the moon at night.
7The Lord will protect you
and keep you safe
from all dangers.
8The Lord will protect you
now and always
wherever you go.
translation_text:
Yawɛ ji wa he bulɔ
1Ke i wo ye yi nɔ nɛ i hyɛ yoku ɔmɛ ɔ,
i biɔ ke jije balɔ maa je kɛ ba?
2Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a,
lɛ ji nɔ nɛ piɛɔ ye he.
3E be hae nɛ o sane kɛ nɔ si.
O he bulɔ ɔ, e de we kɔnɔɛ gblegbleegble.
4O nɛ, Israel he bulɔ ɔ de we kɔnɔɛ,
nɛ e hwɔ we mahe hulɔ.
5Yawɛ ji o yi baalɔ.
E ngɛ o kasa nya, konɛ e bu o he.
6Piani ɔ, pu be mo sããe,
nɛ nyɔ mi hu nyɔhiɔ be mo nɔ́ ko pee.
7Yawɛ maa bu o he kɛ je
yayami tsuo mi;
e maa baa o yi.
8Ke o je kpo jio;
o kpale kɛ ma we mi jio,
Yawɛ maa bu o he.
E maa bu o he kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi
kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
A Song of Praise
1It made me glad when they said,
“Let's go to the house
of the Lord!”
2Jerusalem, we are standing
inside your gates.
3Jerusalem, what a strong
and beautiful city you are!
4Every tribe of the Lord
obeys him and comes to you
to praise his name.
5David's royal throne is here
where justice rules.
6Jerusalem, we pray
that you will have peace,
and that all will go well
for those who love you.
7May there be peace
inside your city walls
and in your palaces.
8Because of my friends
and my relatives,
I will pray for peace.
9And because of the house
of the Lord our God,
I will work for your good.
translation_text:
Yerusalem yi jemi la
1Ye bua jɔ ye he wawɛɛ nitsɛ
benɛ a de mi ke,
“Waa ho Yawɛ we ɔ ya.”
2Yerusalem, jehanɛ lɛɛ
wa ba sɛ o we agbo ɔmɛ a mi!
3Yerusalem ji ma nguaa saminyayoo
nɛ a to lɛ si kɛ e mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́
ngɛ hanɔhanɔ.
4Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ yaa
ya naa Yawɛ si
kaa bɔ nɛ a fa Israel ma a
ke a pee ɔ.
5Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Israel matsɛmɛ nɛ ji
David nina a hi kɛ kojo ma a.
6Nyɛɛ fa kue nɛ tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba Yerusalem.
Nyɛ de ke, “Nihi nɛ suɔ mo Yerusalem ɔ,
níhi a mi nɛ hi ha mɛ oo!
7Tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba ma a mi;
he jɔmi nɛ hi mɔ ɔmɛ a mi.”
8Ye nyɛmimɛ, kɛ ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ,
ma de Yerusalem ke,
“Tue mi jɔmi nɛ hi o mi!”
9Yawɛ wa Mawu ɔ we ɔ he je ɔ,
ma hla o nɔ yami.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for Mercy
1Our Lord and our God,
I turn my eyes to you,
on your throne in heaven.
2Servants look to their master,
but we will look to you,
until you have mercy on us.
3Please have mercy, Lord!
We have been insulted
more than we can stand,
4and we can't take more abuse
from those proud,
conceited people.
translation_text:
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ
1Yawɛ mo i wo ye yi nɔ kɛ ngɛ hyɛe;
mo nɛ́ o hii si ngɛ o matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ
ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ,
mo i ngɛ hyɛe ɔ nɛ!
2O nɛ, bɔ nɛ tsɔli hyɛɛ a nyɔmtsɛ blɔ,
nɛ mawayo hu hyɛɛ e wenyɛ blɔ ɔ,
ja nɔuu wɔ hu wa ngɛ
Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ blɔ hyɛe
kɛ yaa su be nɛ e maa na wɔ mɔbɔ.
3Naa wɔ mɔbɔ;
Yawɛ, naa wɔ mɔbɔ;
ejakaa a pee wɔ nisɛ ní babauu tsɔ.
4Nihi nɛ a he mi jɔ mɛ ɔ ye wa he fɛu babauu,
nɛ he nɔ woli hu gbe wa he guɛ hluu
kɛ ya si wa mumu nya ta.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
Thanking the Lord for Victory
1The Lord was on our side!
Let everyone in Israel say:
2“The Lord was on our side!
Otherwise, the enemy attack
3would have killed us all,
because it was furious.
4We would have been swept away
in a violent flood
5of high and roaring waves.”
6Let's praise the Lord!
He protected us from enemies
who were like wild animals,
7and we escaped like birds
from a hunter's torn net.
8The Lord made heaven and earth,
and he is the one
who sends us help.
translation_text:
Mawu ji e ma a he bulɔ
1Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ piɛ wa he ɔ nɛɛ?
Israel ha heto koo!
2“Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ piɛ wa he
be mi nɛ wa he nyɛli te si kɛ wo wɔ ɔ,
3jinɛ bɔ nɛ a mi mi fu wɔ wawɛɛ nɛ ɔ,
a ko mii wɔ hɛ ngmengmle;
4jinɛ nyu babauu ɔ ko sá wɔ kɛ ho
nɛ e ha wa nɔ;
5nɛ nyu hamahama a ko kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.”
6Nyɛ ha waa na Yawɛ si;
ejakaa e ha we nɛ wa plɛ pee
wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a lungu nya lo!
7Wa je a dɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ jee ya mi;
ya a gba, nɛ wa je mi slɔkee.
8Yawɛ, hiɔwe kɛ zugba bɔlɔ ɔ
ji nɔ nɛ piɛɔ wa he.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord's People Are Safe
1Everyone who trusts the Lord
is like Mount Zion
that cannot be shaken
and will stand forever.
2Just as Jerusalem is protected
by mountains on every side,
the Lord protects his people
by holding them in his arms
now and forever.
3He won't let the wicked
rule his people
or lead them to do wrong.
4Let's ask the Lord to be kind
to everyone who is good
and completely obeys him.
5When the Lord punishes
the wicked,
he will punish everyone else
who lives an evil life.
Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_text:
Mawu ma a naa tue mi jɔmi
1Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ,
a ngɛ kaa Zion yo ɔ.
E maa si kpɛii kɛ yaa neneene,
nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe ma mimiɛ lɛ.
2Bɔ nɛ yohi bɔle Yerusalem kɛ kpe ɔ,
ja Yawɛ he wami ɔ bɔle e ma a kɛ kpe
kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa neneene tsuo.
3Yiwutsotsɛmɛ be nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a
a zugba nɔ yee daa,
ke pi ja a, dali po maa pee yayami.
4Yawɛ, nihi nɛ peeɔ kpakpa,
kɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da
kɛ je a tsui mi ɔ,
ha nɛ e hi ha mɛ.
5Nihi nɛ a blɔ ɔmɛ dɛ ɔ,
Yawɛ maa gbla a kɛ yayami peeli tsuo a tue.
He jɔmi nɛ hi Israel.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Celebrating the Harvest
1It seemed like a dream
when the Lord brought us back
to the city of Zion.
2We celebrated with laughter
and joyful songs.
In foreign nations it was said,
“The Lord has worked miracles
for his people.”
3And so we celebrated
because the Lord had indeed
worked miracles for us.
4Our Lord, we ask you to bless
our people again,
and let us be like streams
in the Southern Desert.
5We cried as we went out
to plant our seeds.
Now let us celebrate
as we bring in the crops.
6We cried on the way
to plant our seeds,
but we will celebrate and shout
as we bring in the crops.
translation_text:
Ba kpɔ mi
1Benɛ Yawɛ kpale wɔ
kɛ je ma se kɛ ba Zion ekohu ɔ,
e pee wɔ kaa pe wa ngɛ nlae.
2Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, wa muɔ jɛɛ,
nɛ wa la bua jɔmi la boboobo.
Je ma amɛ hu de a sibi ke,
“Yawɛ tsu ní nguanguahi ha mɛ.”
3Niinɛ, Yawɛ tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha wɔ,
lɔ ɔ he nɛ wa bua jɔ wa he
nɛ wa ngɛ nyae ɔ nɛ!
4Yawɛ, moo kpale wɔ kɛ ba
wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa zugba nɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔmi nɛɛ
nɛ zugba gbigbli naa nyu babaaba
ekohu ɔ.
5Nihi nɛ du ní kɛ vo nyu ɔ
ma kpa ní kɛ bua jɔmi.
6Nɔ nɛ vo nyu hii e hɛ mi kɛ ya duɔ ní ɔ,
e maa tloo niba ní kɛ ba we mi
kɛ bua jɔmi.

english_text:
(A song by Solomon for worship.)
Only the Lord Can Bless a Home
1Without the help of the Lord
it is useless to build a home
or to guard a city.
2It is useless to get up early
and stay up late
in order to earn a living.
God takes care of his own,
even while they sleep.
3Children are a blessing
and a gift from the Lord.
4Having a lot of children
to take care of you
in your old age
is like a warrior
with a lot of arrows.
5The more you have,
the better off you will be,
because they will protect you
when your enemies
attack you in court.
translation_text:
A je Mawu yi, ejakaa e hi
1Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ maa tsu ɔ,
tsu mali gboɔ yaka dengme.
Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ buɔ ma he ɔ,
bulɔ fɔɔ nyɔ yaka gu
kɛ buɔ ma he.
2Yaka gu nyɛ teɔ si makɛ mla,
nɛ gbɔkuɛ hu nyɛ ya hwɔ we si mla.
Nyɛ gboɔ dengme loko nyɛ naa nɔ́ ko bɔɔ pɛ nyɛ yeɔ,
se nɔ nɛ Mawu suɔ e sane ɔ,
e haa e hwɔɔ mahe bɔ nɛ sa.
3Bimɛ ji weto ní nɛ Yawɛ haa nɔ;
bimɛ ji nike ní nɛ e kɛ dlooɔ nɔ.
4Nihe mi bimɛ nɛ a fɔɔ ɔ
ngɛ kaa ta bulɔ dɛ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi.
5Nɔ nɛ kotoku ɔ hyi kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
a gbaa lɛ.
Ke e kɛ e he nyɛli kpe ngɛ kojomi he ɔ,
zo be lɛ gbee.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Rewards His Faithful People
1The Lord will bless you
if you respect him
and obey his laws.
2Your fields will produce,
and you will be happy—
all will go well.
3Your wife will be as fruitful
as a grapevine,
and just as an olive tree
is rich with olives,
your home will be rich
with healthy children.
4This is how the Lord will bless
everyone who respects him.
5I pray that the Lord
will bless you from Zion
and let Jerusalem prosper
as long as you live.
6May you live long enough
to see your grandchildren.
Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_text:
Hiɔwo kpakpa jeɔ Yawɛ tue bumi mi
1A gbaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yee Yawɛ gbeye,
nɛ́ e yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
2O ma na o nya mi ngma bɔ nɛ sa
kɛ je ní nɛ o tsuɔ ɔ mi;
o bua maa jɔ,
nɛ e maa hi ha mo.
3O yo maa pee kaa wai tso
nɛ woɔ yiblii saminyayoo
ngɛ o we ɔ mi;
nɛ o bimɛ maa bɔle o we okplɔɔ ɔ afɛu mi
kaa oliv tsohi nɛ tsɛ̃ kɛ ma.
4Nyumu nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ,
niinɛ, bɔ nɛ a maa gbaa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
5Yawɛ nɛ gbaa mo kɛ je Zion.
O wami be ɔ tsuo ɔ,
o na bɔ nɛ Yerusalem ma plɔke ha.
6O wa, nɛ o na o bibimɛ.
Tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba Israel ma a mi!

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for Protection
1Since the time I was young,
enemies have often attacked!
Let everyone in Israel say:
2“Since the time I was young,
enemies have often attacked!
But they have not defeated me,
3though my back is like a field
that has just been plowed.”
4The Lord always does right,
and he has set me free
from the ropes
of those cruel people.
5I pray that all who hate
the city of Zion
will be made ashamed
and forced to turn and run.
6May they be like grass
on the flat roof of a house,
grass that dries up
as soon as it sprouts.
7Don't let them be like wheat
gathered in bundles.
8And don't let anyone
who passes by say to them,
“The Lord bless you!
I give you my blessing
in the name of the Lord.”
translation_text:
A fa kue kɛ si Israel he nyɛli
1Israel, jehanɛ de,
“Kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si tɔɔ ɔ,
ye he nyɛli wa mi yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ!”
2“Kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si tɔɔ ɔ,
ye he nyɛli wa mi yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ,
se kɛ̃ ɔ, a nyɛ we mi.
3A plaa ye se mi wawɛɛ,
ye se mi pee kaa ngmɔ
nɛ a kɛ kpakplaa hu.
4Yawɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛ e peeɔ;
e je mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.”
5Nihi tsuo nɛ sume Zion ɔ,
zo nɛ gbe mɛ
nɛ a kpale a se!
6A pee kaa nga nɛ ngɛ puɛe ngɛ tsu yi mi;
benɛ e na we nɛ e wa, kɛkɛ e gbli momo.
7Nga nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko fa we,
nɛ a fi we nɛ a tloo kɛ je.
8Nihi nɛ bee ɔ kó de ke,
“Yawɛ nɛ gbaa nyɛ!
Wa ngɛ nyɛ gbaae
ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi!”

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Trusting the Lord in Times of Trouble
1From a sea of troubles
I cry out to you, Lord.
2Won't you please listen
as I beg for mercy?
3If you kept record of our sins,
no one could last long.
4But you forgive us,
and so we will worship you.
5With all my heart,
I am waiting, Lord, for you!
I trust your promises.
6I wait for you more eagerly
than a soldier on guard duty
waits for the dawn.
Yes, I wait more eagerly
than a soldier on guard duty
waits for the dawn.
7Israel, trust the Lord!
God is always merciful
and has the power to save you.
8 Israel, the Lord will save you
from all your sins.
translation_text:
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
1Yawɛ, i ngɛ kue fae ha mo,
ejakaa ye yi fi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
2Nyɔmtsɛ, bu mi tue;
bu ye pɛɛ kpami ɔ tue.
3Ke mo Mawu o ke o maa kane yayamihi ɔ,
Yawɛ, mɛnɔ maa ye e he.
4Se o ngɔɔ yayami kɛ paa,
konɛ a ye mo gbeye.
5I ngɛ Yawɛ blɔ hyɛe;
e munyu ɔ nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
6Ee, Yawɛ blɔ pɛ i ngɛ hyɛe.
I ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe
pe bɔ nɛ ma he buli huɔɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ
kɛ ya suu mɔtu ɔ.
7Israel, ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ,
ejakaa Yawɛ suɔmi ɔ be nyagbe;
lɛ nɛ e heɔ wa yi wami.
8 Lɛ nɔuu lɛ e ma kpɔ Israel
kɛ je a he yayamihi tsuo a mi.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
Trust the Lord!
1I am not conceited, Lord,
and I don't waste my time
on impossible schemes.
2But I have learned to feel safe
and satisfied,
like a young child
in its mother's arms.
3People of Israel,
you must trust the Lord
now and forever.
translation_text:
Ngɔɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ kulaa
1Yawɛ, i wo we ye he nɔ, konɛ ye
hɛngmɛhi nɛ hi hiɔwe níhi pɛ hyɛe;
pohu ní nguanguahi, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ tsɔ
ha mi ɔ, i nyɛɛ we a se.
2Anɔkuale mi ɔ, i ba ye he si,
nɛ i pee kpoo kaa bi nɛ a tsɔ lɛ nyɔ ngɛ e nyɛ kasa nya;
ye klaa pee kpoo ngɛ ye mi kaa bi nɛ a tsɔ lɛ nyɔ.
3Israel, ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ
kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Is Always with His People
1Our Lord, don't forget David
and how he suffered.
2Mighty God of Jacob,
remember how he promised:
3“I won't go home
or crawl into bed
4or close my eyelids,
5until I find a home for you,
the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
6 When we were in Ephrath,
we heard that the sacred chest
was somewhere near Jaar.
7Then we said, “Let's go
to the throne of the Lord
and worship at his feet.”
8Come to your new home, Lord,
you and the sacred chest
with all its power.
9Let victory be like robes
for the priests;
let your faithful people
celebrate and shout.
10David is your chosen one,
so don't reject him.
11 You made a solemn promise
to David, when you said,
“I, the Lord, promise
that someone in your family
will always be king.
12If they keep our agreement
and follow my teachings,
then someone in your family
will rule forever.”
13You have gladly chosen Zion
as your home, our Lord.
14You said, “This is my home!
I will live here forever.
15I will bless Zion with food,
and even the poor will eat
until they are full.
16Victory will be like robes
for the priests,
and its faithful people
will celebrate and shout.
17 I will give mighty power
to the kingdom of David.
Each of my chosen kings
will shine like a lamp
18and wear a sparkling crown.
But I will disgrace
their enemies.”
translation_text:
Yawɛ we ɔ yi jemi la
1Yawɛ, mo kai amanehlu tsuo
nɛ David na a.
2E ka mo Yawɛ kita,
nɛ e wo mo Yakob Mawu Ope ɔ si ke,
3“I be ye we mi yae,
nɛ i ya be si hwɔe hulɔ.
4I be ye hɛ se jee,
nɛ i be kɔnɔɛ tete dee
5kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma na he ko ha mo Yawɛ,
Yakob Mawu Ope ɔ,
konɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ pee o hi he!”
6 Wa nu somi daka a he ngɛ Betlehem,
nɛ wa ya na ngɛ Yearim ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
7Wa de ke, “Nyɛ ha waa ya Yawɛ we ɔ
nɛ wa ya kpla si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi!”
8Yawɛ, mo wo o he nɔ,
nɛ o ba o he jɔɔmi he ɔ;
ngɔɔ somi daka a nɛ ji o he wami okadi ɔ hu kɛ ba.
9Ha nɛ o we osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da be tsuaa be,
nɛ o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ a hwɔ lele!
10Yawɛ, mo nitsɛ lɛ o wo o tsɔlɔ David si,
nɛ o wo lɛ matsɛ,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ko kua lɛ.
11 Yawɛ, kita nɛ o ka David
nɛ o be o nya se kpalee ji,
“Ma wo o bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake matsɛ,
nɛ e maa ye tsɛ ngɛ o se.
12Ke o bimɛ ɔmɛ maa ye ye somi ɔ nɔ,
nɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ ma wo mɛ ɔ hu
a maa ye a nɔ ɔ,
lɛɛ a bimɛ hu ma ba hi o sɛ ɔ nɔ
kɛ maa ya neneene.”
13Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ suɔ nɛ e hla Zion
kaa lejɛ ɔ nɛ e maa hi.
14E de ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ma hi kɛ maa ya neneene;
hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ma jɔɔ ye he ngɛ;
ejakaa i suɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ.
15Ma ha Zion ma na niye ní babauu,
ma a mi ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa ye ní maa tɔ.
16Ma gbaa osɔfo ɔmɛ a ní tsumi nɔ,
nɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ma hwɔ lele!
17 Ma pee David nina kake matsɛ agbo
ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ;
ma to lɛ si kaa nɔ nɛ imi nitsɛ i hla, nɛ i wo lɛ matsɛ.
18Ma ha zo maa gbe e he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpɔtɔɔ,
se e tsɛ yemi ɔ maa bɔ,
nɛ e ma he biɛ saminya.”

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Living Together in Peace
1It is truly wonderful
when the people of God
live together in peace.
2It is as beautiful as olive oil
poured on Aaron's head
and running down his beard
and the collar of his robe.
3It is like the dew
from Mount Hermon,
falling on Zion's mountains,
where the Lord has promised
to bless his people
with life forevermore.
translation_text:
Nyɛmi suɔmi la
1Hyɛ bɔ nɛ e hi, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ fɛu,
ke nyɛmimɛ pee kake kɛ hi si!
2Nyɛmimɛ a kake peemi ngɛ kaa nu nɛ he jua wa
nɛ a kɛ pɔ Aaron yi mi,
nɛ ngɛ dɛe kɛ ngɛ e kpɛni mi puee
hluu kɛ ba su e tade klɔii ɔ nya tɔɔ!
3Nyɛmimɛ a kake peemi ngɛ kaa bɔ́ ngɛ Hermon yo ɔ nɔ;
e ngɛ kaa bɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɛe ngɛ Zion yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo si ngɛ
ke e maa gbaa e ma a
kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Praising the Lord at Night
1Everyone who serves the Lord,
come and offer praises.
Everyone who has gathered
in his temple tonight,
2lift your hands in prayer
toward his holy place
and praise the Lord.
3The Lord is the Creator
of heaven and earth,
and I pray that the Lord
will bless you from Zion.
translation_text:
A je Mawu yi
1Nyɛ Yawɛ tsɔli tsuo, nyɛɛ ba;
nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ
ngɛ e we ɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ,
nyɛ je e yi
2Nyɛ wo nyɛ nine nɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ,
nɛ nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.
3Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba a,
é gbaa nyɛ kɛ je Zion.

english_text:
In Praise of the Lord's Kindness
1Shout praises to the Lord!
You are his servants,
so praise his name.
2All who serve in the temple
of the Lord our God,
3come and shout praises.
Praise the name of the Lord!
He is kind and good.
4He chose the family of Jacob
and the people of Israel
for his very own.
5The Lord is much greater
than any other god.
6He does as he chooses
in heaven and on earth
and deep in the sea.
7The Lord makes the clouds rise
from far across the earth,
and he makes lightning
to go with the rain.
Then from his secret place
he sends out the wind.
8The Lord killed the first-born
of people and animals
in the land of Egypt.
9God used miracles and wonders
to fight the king of Egypt
and all of his officials.
10He destroyed many nations
and killed powerful kings,
11including King Sihon
of the Amorites
and King Og of Bashan.
He conquered every kingdom
in the land of Canaan
12and gave their property
to his people Israel.
13The name of the Lord
will be remembered forever,
and he will be famous
for all time to come.
14The Lord will bring justice
and show mercy to all
who serve him.
15 Idols of silver and gold
are made and worshiped
in other nations.
16They have a mouth and eyes,
but they can't speak or see.
17They are completely deaf,
and they can't breathe.
18Everyone who makes idols
and all who trust them
will end up as helpless
as their idols.
19Everyone in Israel,
come praise the Lord!
All the family of Aaron
20and all the tribe of Levi,
come praise the Lord!
All of his worshipers,
come praise the Lord.
21Praise the Lord from Zion!
He lives here in Jerusalem.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Yi jemi la
1Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ je Yawɛ biɛ ɔ yi!
Nyɛ Yawɛ tsɔli tsuo,
nyɛ je e yi!
2Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ,
ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ he klɔuklɔu ɔ,
nyɛ je e yi!
3Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi, ejakaa Yawɛ hi;
nyɛ la kɛ je e biɛ ɔ yi,
ejakaa e mi mi hi.
4Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ hla Yakob kɛ ha e he;
e hla Israel kɛ pee e ma.
5Imi lɛɛ i le kaa Yawɛ kle;
Yawɛ kle pe mawu ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa.
6Hiɔwe ɔ jio, zugba a nɔ jio,
wo ɔ mi jio,
muɔ voovoo ɔmɛ a mi jio,
nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ́ Yawɛ suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ e peeɔ.
7Lɛ nɛ e haa bɔku teɔ si ngɛ je ɔ nyagbe he;
e pee oslabai kɛ ha hiɔmi,
nɛ e jeɔ kɔɔhiɔ kpo kɛ jee e to he ɔmɛ.
8Lɛ nɛ e gbe kekleekle bimɛ tsuo ngɛ Egipt,
nimli adesahi a bimɛ, kɛ lohwehi a bimɛ.
9Lɛ nɛ tsu nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi
kɛ gbla Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a tue.
10Lɛ nɛ kpata je mahi babauu a hɛ mi,
nɛ e gbe matsɛmɛ nguangua nɛ ɔmɛ:
11Sihon, Amor bi a matsɛ ɔ,
Og, Bashan matsɛ ɔ,
kɛ Kanaan matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo;
12nɛ e ngɔ a zugba a kɛ ha e ma, Israel
kaa a weto ní.
13Yawɛ, o biɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene;
Yawɛ, yi nɔhi tsuo ma kai mo.
14Yawɛ ma fa e ma a he;
e maa na e tsɔli ɔmɛ mɔbɔ.
15 Je ma amɛ a we amaga amɛ ɔ,
sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu sɔuu,
nimli adesahi a nine nya ní tsumi ji mɛ.
16A ngɛ nya, se a tu we munyu;
a ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́.
17A ngɛ tue, se a nui nɔ́;
mumi ko hu be a gugwɔ mi nɛ a woɔ.
18I ná nɛ nihi nɛ pee mɛ,
kɛ nihi nɛ ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ ɔ tsuo
pee kaa amaga amɛ nɛ a pee ɔ nɔuu!
19Nyɛ Israel ma, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ Mawu we osɔfohi, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
20Nyɛ Levi bi, nyɛ je e yi;
nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ yee Yawɛ gbeye,
nyɛ je e yi!
21Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi ngɛ Zion;
nyɛ je e yi ngɛ e we ɔ mi ngɛ Yerusalem.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

english_text:
God's Love Never Fails
1 Praise the Lord! He is good.
God's love never fails.
2Praise the God of all gods.
God's love never fails.
3Praise the Lord of lords.
God's love never fails.
4Only God works great miracles.
God's love never fails.
5 With wisdom he made the sky.
God's love never fails.
6 The Lord stretched the earth
over the ocean.
God's love never fails.
7 He made the bright lights
in the sky.
God's love never fails.
8He lets the sun rule each day.
God's love never fails.
9He lets the moon and the stars
rule each night.
God's love never fails.
10 God struck down the first-born
in every Egyptian family.
God's love never fails.
11 He rescued Israel from Egypt.
God's love never fails.
12God used his great strength
and his powerful arm.
God's love never fails.
13 He split the Red Sea apart.
God's love never fails.
14The Lord brought Israel safely
through the sea.
God's love never fails.
15He destroyed the Egyptian king
and his army there.
God's love never fails.
16The Lord led his people
through the desert.
God's love never fails.
17Our God defeated mighty kings.
God's love never fails.
18And he killed famous kings.
God's love never fails.
19 One of them was Sihon,
king of the Amorites.
God's love never fails.
20 Another was King Og of Bashan.
God's love never fails.
21God took away their land.
God's love never fails.
22He gave their land to Israel,
the people who serve him.
God's love never fails.
23God saw the trouble we were in.
God's love never fails.
24He rescued us from our enemies.
God's love never fails.
25He gives food to all who live.
God's love never fails.
26Praise God in heaven!
God's love never fails.

A Prayer for Revenge
1Beside the rivers of Babylon
we thought about Jerusalem,
and we sat down and cried.
2We hung our small harps
on the willow trees.
3Our enemies had brought us here
as their prisoners;
now they wanted us to sing
and entertain them.
They insulted us and shouted,
“Sing about Zion!”
4Here in a foreign land,
how can we sing
about the Lord?
5Jerusalem, if I forget you,
let my right hand go limp.
6Let my tongue stick
to the roof of my mouth,
if I don't think about you
above all else.
7Our Lord, punish the Edomites!
On the day Jerusalem fell,
they shouted,
“Completely destroy the city!
Tear down every building!”
8 Babylon, you are doomed!
I pray the Lord's blessings
on anyone who punishes you
for what you did to us.
9May the Lord bless everyone
who beats your children
against the rocks!
translation_text:
Israel bi ɔmɛ ye kɔmɔ ngɛ ma se.
1Babilon pa amɛ a tue wa hi si ngɛ nɛ wa wo yana,
benɛ wa kai Zion ɔ.
2Wa ngɔ wa kpa saku ɔmɛ ngɔ
kpla tsohi a he ngɛ pa a tue.
3Ejakaa nihi nɛ nuu wɔ
kɛ ho ma se ya a de wɔ ke wa la ha mɛ.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ wɔ haoe ɔ suɔ kaa wa je a hɛja;
a de wɔ ke, “Nyɛ la Zion la amɛ eko ha wɔ!”
4Mɛni he je wa ma la Yawɛ la ngɛ ma se?
5Ke ye hɛ je mo Yerusalem, o nɔ ɔ,
lɛɛ ye hiɔ nine nɛ gbo.
6Ke i kaii we mo Yerusalem,
nɛ ke i bui mo kaa
nɔ nɛ haa mi bua jɔmi pe kulaa a,
lɛɛ ye lilɛ nɛ mɛtɛ ye nya mi.
7Yawɛ, mo kai nɔ́ nɛ Edom bi ɔmɛ
pee Yerusalem ligbi ko ɔ.
Edom bi ɔmɛ de ke,
“Nyɛɛ ku ma a kɛ pue si;
nyɛɛ ku lɛ pue si
kɛ ya su e sisi tomi ɔmɛ tɔɔ!”
8 Mo Babilon, ja a kpata o hɛ mi kokooko!
A gbaa nɔ nɛ maa pee mo kɛ to nane mi
kaa bɔ nɛ o pee wɔ ɔ.
9A gbaa nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ o bimɛ
tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ kɛ fiaa tɛ sa.

english_text:
(By David.)
Praise the Lord with All Your Heart
1With all my heart
I praise you, Lord.
In the presence of angels
I sing your praises.
2I worship at your holy temple
and praise you for your love
and your faithfulness.
You were true to your word
and made yourself more famous
than ever before.
3When I asked for your help,
you answered my prayer
and gave me courage.
4All kings on this earth
have heard your promises, Lord,
and they will praise you.
5You are so famous
that they will sing about
the things you have done.
6Though you are above us all,
you care for humble people,
and you keep a close watch
on everyone who is proud.
7I am surrounded by trouble,
but you protect me
against my angry enemies.
With your own powerful arm
you keep me safe.
8You, Lord, will always
treat me with kindness.
Your love never fails.
You have made us what we are.
Don't give up on us now!
translation_text:
Sina
1Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo si nae kɛ ye tsui tsuo.
I ngɛ lae kɛ ngɛ o yi jee ngɛ
Mawu kpa amɛ a hɛ mi po.
2I ngɔ ye hɛ mi kɛ bu si
kɛ kpee sɔlemi we klɔuklɔu ɔ;
nɛ i ngɛ mo si nae
kaa o suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa,
nɛ o yeɔ anɔkuale jã kɛ̃.
Jehanɛ hu o ha nɛ a na kaa
o biɛ kle pe biɛ tsuaa biɛ,
nɛ o munyu hu he jua wa
pe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
3Ligbi ɔ nɛ i tsɛ mo ɔ, o he nɔ.
O wo mi kã, nɛ ye nɔ gbagba te.
4Yawɛ, matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ
mi ɔ ma je o yi,
ejakaa munyu nɛ je o nya a, a nu.
5A ma la kɛ gba nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ;
a ma la ma de ke o hɛ mi nyami ɔ kle.
6Yawɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo mohu,
se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ,
e hɛ hii e nɔ;
nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ lɛɛ
e he sane ko pi Yawɛ sane.
7Ke i ngɛ amanehlu mi ɔ,
mo lɛ o jeɔ mi kɛ jeɔ mi.
Ke ye he nyɛli kɛ abofu ba na mi ɔ,
o kɛ mɛ kpee,
nɛ o kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ
heɔ ye yi wami.
8Yawɛ, yi mi nɛ o to ha mi ɔ,
o maa ye nɔ,
ejakaa Yawɛ, o suɔmi ɔ ngɛ
kɛ yaa neneene.
Ní tsumi nɛ o je sisi ɔ,
koo ngmɛɛ he.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
The Lord Is Always Near
1You have looked deep
into my heart, Lord,
and you know all about me.
2You know when I am resting
or when I am working,
and from heaven
you discover my thoughts.
3You notice everything I do
and everywhere I go.
4Before I even speak a word,
you know what I will say,
5and with your powerful arm
you protect me
from every side.
6I can't understand all of this!
Such wonderful knowledge
is far above me.
7Where could I go to escape
from your Spirit
or from your sight?
8If I were to climb up
to the highest heavens,
you would be there.
If I were to dig down
to the world of the dead
you would also be there.
9Suppose I had wings
like the dawning day
and flew across the ocean.
10Even then your powerful arm
would guide and protect me.
11Or suppose I said, “I'll hide
in the dark until night comes
to cover me over.”
12But you see in the dark
because daylight and dark
are all the same to you.
13You are the one
who put me together
inside my mother's body,
14and I praise you because of
the wonderful way
you created me.
Everything you do is marvelous!
Of this I have no doubt.
15Nothing about me
is hidden from you!
I was secretly woven together
out of human sight,
16but with your own eyes you saw
my body being formed.
Even before I was born,
you had written in your book
everything about me.
17 Your thoughts are far beyond
my understanding,
much more than I
could ever imagine.
18I try to count your thoughts,
but they outnumber the grains
of sand on the beach.
And when I awake,
I will find you nearby.
19How I wish that you would kill
all cruel and heartless people
and protect me from them!
20They are always rebelling
and speaking evil of you.
21You know I hate anyone
who hates you, Lord,
and refuses to obey.
22They are my enemies too,
and I truly hate them.
23Look deep into my heart, God,
and find out everything
I am thinking.
24Don't let me follow evil ways,
but lead me in the way
that time has proven true.
translation_text:
Mawu le nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nɛ e baa wa yi
1Yawɛ, o hyɛ ye mi tsuo,
nɛ o le bɔ nɛ i ngɛ.
2Ye si himi, kɛ ye si temi tsuo o le,
ye yi mi tomi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, o le momo.
3Ke i ma blɔ ɔ, o le
nɛ ke i hwɔ si hu o le;
ee, ye ní peemi níhi tsuo o le.
4Loko ma pa ye nya mi ke ma de nɔ́ ko ɔ,
mo Yawɛ, o le lɛ tsuo momo.
5O ngɔ o he wami kɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe,
nɛ o buɔ ye he.
6Bɔ nɛ o le mi fitsofitso ɔ ngɛ nyakpɛ tsɔ.
Nile nɛ ɔ mi kuɔ pe bɔ nɛ
ma nyɛ ma nu sisi.
7Jije ma je o mumi ɔ hɛ mi kɛ maa ya?
Jije ma ya laa ye he ngɛ
nɛ o be mi nae?
8Ke i kuɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe ɔ,
ne mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ;
nɛ ke i ya hwɔ si ngɛ gbeje hu
ne mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
9Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ ji mi,
nɛ i te papaapa kɛ je beleku je
kɛ ya ma bonyoku je se lokoo;
10lejɛ ɔ tete po mo lɛ o maa tsɔɔ mi blɔ,
nɛ o hiɔ nine maa su ye nɔ.
11Ke i de ke diblii ba ha ye nɔ,
loo pu la nɛ bɔle mi ɔ nɛ plɛ pee diblii ɔ,
12lɔ ɔ lɛɛ yaka gu, ejakaa diblii pee we diblii ha mo,
nɛ nyɔ mi tsɔɔ heii kaa piani nɔuu;
diblii jio, la jio, lɛ tsuo kake ha mo.
13Ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi níhi tsuo ɔ,
mo lɛ o pee.
O puɛ mi ngɛ ye nyɛ muklii mi tɔɔ.
14I ngɛ o yi jee,
ejakaa bɔ nɛ o plɛ kɛ bɔ mi ɔ,
e ngɛ gbeye,
nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ hulɔ.
Níhi nɛ o pee ɔ ngɛ nyakpɛ loo!
O le mi fitsofitso.
15Benɛ a ngɛ mi puɛe ngɛ laami mi,
nɛ wu ɔmɛ ngɛ wae ngɛ ye nyɛ muklii mi tɔɔ ɔ,
i fɔɔ si paa ngɛ o hɛ mi.
16Benɛ a na we nɛ a fɔ mi lolo po ɔ,
a ngma ye wami be ɔ tsuo
ngɛ o womi ɔ mi momo.
17Mawu, yi mi tomi nɛ o ngɛ ha mi ɔ
he jua wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Ní kpakpahi nɛ o susuɔ ha mi ɔ,
a he hiɛ babauu.
18Ke i ke ma kane mɛ ɔ,
i be nyɛe,
ejakaa a he hiɛ babauu pe zia.
Loko ye hɛ maa tsɛ po
o ngɛ ye he susue momo.
19Mawu, i na nɛ o gbe yiwusotsɛmɛ,
konɛ ma ye ye he
kɛ je muɔ si pueli nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
20Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tuɔ musu bɔmi munyu,
nɛ a teɔ si kɛ woɔ mo.
21Nihi nɛ bui mo ɔ, anɛ imi lɛɛ i buɔ mɛ lo?
Nihi nɛ tsɔɔ o hɛ mi atuã a,
anɛ i suɔ mɛ lo?
22Dɛbi, i sume mɛ saasaa;
i buɔ mɛ ye he nyɛli.
23Mawu, hyɛ ye tsui mi
nɛ o le mi.
Kaa mi nɛ o hyɛ,
nɛ o na níhi nɛ ngɛ ye juɛmi mi.
24Hyɛ kaa yayami ko pa ngɛ ye mi lo,
nɛ o ngɔ mi kɛ fɔ blɔ
nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa neneene wami mi ɔ nɔ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1Rescue me from cruel
and violent enemies, Lord!
2They think up evil plans
and always cause trouble.
3 Their words bite deep
like the poisonous fangs
of a snake.
4Protect me, Lord, from cruel
and brutal enemies,
who want to destroy me.
5Those proud people have hidden
traps and nets
to catch me as I walk.
6You, Lord, are my God!
Please listen to my prayer.
7You have the power to save me,
and you keep me safe
in every battle.
8Don't let the wicked succeed
in doing what they want,
or else they might never
stop planning evil.
9They have me surrounded,
but make them the victims
of their own vicious lies.
10Dump flaming coals on them
and throw them into pits
where they can't climb out.
11Chase those cruel liars away!
Let trouble hunt them down.
12Our Lord, I know that you
defend the homeless
and see that the poor
are given justice.
13Your people will praise you
and will live with you
because they do right.
translation_text:
Kue fami kɛ ha yi baami
1Yawɛ, mo he ye yi wami;
jé mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.
2Mɛɛ lɛɛ yayami he pɛ a susuɔ.
Daa nɛ ɔ, pɛ kɛkɛ a ngɛ woe.
3 A lilɛ ngɛ kaa sinɔ duɔtsɛ nɔ́.
A munyu ngɛ kaa sanga duɔ.
4Yawɛ, bu ye he;
jé mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi;
ejakaa a to a yi mi kaa a maa tsɛ̃ mi kɛ fia si.
5He nɔ woli tsɔ klamahi ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a tue.
A tsɔ mi klama, konɛ a du mi.
6I deɔ Yawɛ ke, “Mo ji ye Mawu!”
Yawɛ, moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue!
7Ye Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ye yi wami helɔ kpanaa,
ta be mi ɔ, mo nɔuu lɛ o baa ye yi.
8Yawɛ, koo ngmɛ yayami peeli blɔ nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ;
ko ha nɛ a yi mi tomi yaya amɛ nɛ ba mi.
9Nihi nɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe ɔ ngɛ ye he gbeye woe.
Ha nɛ ga yaya nɛ a ngɛ toe ngɛ ye he ɔ
nɛ kpata mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi.
10Ha nɛ la ngu hɛuu ba pue a nɔ!
A ya nɔ muɔ mi
nɛ a ko nyɛ kpo nɛ a je gblegbleegble.
11Ko ha lakpatsɛmɛ nɛ gbeɔ nɔ he guɛ
nɛ a plɔke ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Ha nɛ yayami peeli a hɛ mi nɛ kpata amlɔ nɔuu.
12Yawɛ, i le kaa nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ,
mo lɛ o hyɛɛ a nɔ,
nɛ o yeɔ ohiatsɛmɛ a sane ha mɛ.
13Niinɛ, nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a
maa na mo si;
kpakpa peeli kɛ mo maa hi si daa.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Protection
1I pray to you, Lord!
Please listen when I pray
and hurry to help me.
2 Think of my prayer
as sweet-smelling incense,
and think of my lifted hands
as an evening sacrifice.
3Help me to guard my words
whenever I say something.
4Don't let me want to do evil
or waste my time doing wrong
with wicked people.
Don't let me even taste
the good things they offer.
5Let your faithful people
correct and punish me.
My prayers condemn the deeds
of those who do wrong,
so don't let me be friends
with any of them.
6Everyone will admit
that I was right
when their rulers are thrown
down a rocky cliff,
7and their bones lie scattered
like crushed rocks
on top of a grave.
8You are my Lord and God,
and I look to you for safety.
Don't let me be harmed.
9Protect me from the traps
of those violent people,
10and make them fall
into their own traps
while you help me escape.
translation_text:
Kue nɛ a faa gbɔkuɛ
1Yawɛ, mo i ngɛ tsɛe;
o he nɛ sɔ ha mi;
mo i ngɛ tsɛe boboobo ɔ nɛ,
bu mi tue koo!
2 Ha nɛ ye kue fami ɔ nɛ je via
kaa tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ o hɛ mi;
nɛ ye nine nɛ i wo nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe ɔ,
e pee kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ sãe
gbɔkuɛ nya si ha mo.
3Yawɛ, moo to bulɔ nɛ hyɛ ye nya nɔ,
konɛ e hyɛ ye munyu tumi nɔ.
4Piɛ ye he, konɛ ma ko na yayami peemi he bua jɔmi;
piɛ ye he, konɛ i kɛ yayami peeli ko bɔ;
nɛ ko ha ma ya ye a niye ní
ngɔngɔɛ ɔ eko.
5Ha nɛ dalɔ nɛ gba mi ma,
nɛ e ngɔ e mi mi himi ɔ kɛ ka ye hɛ mi;
se ko ha nɛ yayami peeli nɛ a je ye yi;
ejakaa be tsuaa be ɔ, i faa kue
kɛ siɔ a yayami ɔmɛ.
6Ke a ngɔ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo nihi
nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi a dɛ mi ɔ,
ma a ma na maa le kaa
Yawɛ munyu ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi.
7Ke a ngɛ tɛ sa gbae ɔ,
bɔ nɛ tɛ ɔ gbɛɛ kɛ fĩaa zugba a
tsuo nɔ ɔ,
ja a ma sake a wuhi
kɛ pue gbeje agbo ɔ nya.
8Se mo Yawɛ ye Nyɔmtsɛ i ngɛ hyɛe;
mo ji ye wesa he;
koo ngmɛɛ ye he kulaa kɛ fɔ si;
bu ye he.
9Je mi kɛ je klama nɛ he nyɛli
tsɔ mi ɔ mi.
Je mi kɛ je yayami peeli a klama mi.
10Ha nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsuo
nɛ a ya nɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a klamahi a mi,
se imi lɛɛ ha ma je a mi slɔkee.

english_text:
(A special psalm and a prayer by David when he was in the cave.)
A Prayer for Help
1 I pray to you, Lord.
I beg for mercy.
2I tell you all my worries
and my troubles,
3and whenever I feel low,
you are there to guide me.
A trap has been hidden
along my pathway.
4Even if you look,
you won't see anyone
who cares enough
to walk beside me.
There is no place to hide,
and no one who really cares.
5I pray to you, Lord!
You are my place of safety,
and you are my choice
in the land of the living.
Please answer my prayer.
I am completely helpless.
6Help! They are chasing me,
and they are too strong.
7Rescue me from this prison,
so I can praise your name.
And when your people notice
your wonderful kindness to me,
they will rush to my side.
translation_text:
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
1 Yawɛ i ngɛ tsɛe wawɛɛ
ke e ba piɛ ye he ɔ nɛ.
I wo ye gbi nɔ wawɛɛ kɛ ngɛ lɛ pɛɛ kpae.
2I ngɔ ye kɔmɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba e hɛ mi;
i de lɛ ye haomi ɔmɛ tsuo.
3Benɛ ye nine mi miɔ nɛ e wo nyu ɔ,
moo lɛɛ o le ye hiami ɔ mo.
Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsɔ mi klama
ngɛ ye blɔ ɔ mi.
4Ke i hyɛ ye hiɔ nɔ ɔ,
nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa je ngmlaa ha mi;
wesa he ko kulaa be ha mi,
nɔ ko nɔ ko bui ye he akɔtaa.
5Yawɛ, mo i ngɛ tsɛe ɔ nɛ.
I ngɛ dee ke
mo pɛ ji ye wesa he ngɛ je ɔ mi.
6Moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue koo,
ejakaa peepee ta ye he kulaa.
Kpɔ mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.
7Ye yi fi; ejakaa a he wa pe mi.
Je mi, konɛ ma na mo si
ngɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a hɛ mi;
ejakaa kpakpa nitsɛnitsɛ o maa pee mi ɔ nɛ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A Prayer in Time of Danger
1Listen, Lord, as I pray!
You are faithful and honest
and will answer my prayer.
2 I am your servant.
Don't try me in your court,
because no one is innocent
by your standards.
3My enemies are chasing me,
crushing me in the ground.
I am in total darkness,
like someone long dead.
4I have given up hope,
and I feel numb all over.
5I remember to think about
the many things you did
in years gone by.
6Then I lift my hands in prayer,
because my soul is a desert,
thirsty for water from you.
7Please hurry, Lord,
and answer my prayer.
I feel hopeless.
Don't turn away
and leave me here to die.
8Each morning let me learn
more about your love
because I trust you.
I come to you in prayer,
asking for your guidance.
9Please rescue me
from my enemies, Lord!
I come to you for safety.
10You are my God. Show me
what you want me to do,
and let your gentle Spirit
lead me in the right path.
11Be true to your name, Lord,
and keep my life safe.
Use your saving power
to protect me from trouble.
12I am your servant.
Show how much you love me
by destroying my enemies.
translation_text:
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
1Yawɛ bu ye kue fami ɔ tue;
mo ta tue ha pɛɛ nɛ i ngɛ mo kpae ɔ.
Akɛnɛ o yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
bu mi tue nɛ o he nɔ ha mi koo!
2 O kɛ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ kó ye sane;
ejakaa nɔmlɔ adesa ko adesa ko be nguɔ yee
ngɛ o hɛ mi.
3Ye he nyɛlɔ ɔ nyɛɛ ye se
nɛ e ma kpata ye hɛ mi.
E fia mi nɔ́ wawɛɛ,
nɛ e tsɛ̃ ye yi se ngɔ wo diblii kpii mi;
i pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ gbo momoomo.
4Ye mumu nya ta jehanɛ,
nɛ peepee ta ye he!
5I kaii sa blema a,
nɛ i susuɔ níhi tsuo nɛ o tsu ɔ a he;
i susuɔ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ a he.
6I woɔ ye nine nɔ kɛ yaa hiɔwe kɛ faa kue.
Bɔ nɛ zugba gbigbli hlaa nyu kɛ jɔɔ e he ɔ,
ja o he kuma ngɛ mi yee.
7Yawɛ, he mi nɔ esɔ koo!
Ye hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi tsuo miɔ nɛ e ta.
Koo ngɔ o he kɛ laa mi;
ke pi ja a, i kɛ gbogboe ɔmɛ ngɛ gbeje maa sɔ.
8Mɔtu ɔ, ha ma kai bɔ nɛ o mi mi hi ha;
ejakaa o nɔ i ngɔɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔɔ.
Ha nɛ ma le he nɛ ma gu;
ejakaa mo pɛ o nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
9Yawɛ, jé mi kɛ je ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
O ngɔ i ba sa we ngɛ.
10Moo tsɔɔ mi nɛ ma pee nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ;
ejakaa mo ji ye Mawu.
Ha nɛ o mumi kpakpa a nɛ tsɔɔ mi blɔ nɛ hi,
nɛ e nɔ jɔ.
11Yawɛ, mo he ye yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.
O peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, lɔ ɔ he ɔ,
mo je mi kɛ je haomi mi.
12O suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ he je ɔ,
moo gbe ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ;
nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mi haoe ɔ,
mo kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ;
ejakaa o tsɔlɔ ji mi.

english_text:
(By David.)
A Prayer for the Nation
1I praise you, Lord!
You are my mighty rock,
and you teach me
how to fight my battles.
2You are my friend, my fortress,
where I am safe.
You are my shield,
and you made me the ruler
of our people.
3 Why do we humans mean anything
to you, our Lord?
Why do you care about us?
4We disappear like a breath;
we last no longer
than a faint shadow.
5Open the heavens like a curtain
and come down, Lord.
Touch the mountains
and make them send up smoke.
6Use your lightning as arrows
to scatter my enemies
and make them run away.
7Reach down from heaven
and set me free.
Save me from the mighty flood
8of those lying foreigners
who never tell the truth.
9In praise of you, our God,
I will sing a new song,
while playing my harp.
10By your power, kings win wars,
and your servant David is saved
from deadly swords.
11Won't you keep me safe
from those lying foreigners
who never tell the truth?
12Let's pray that our young sons
will grow like strong plants
and that our daughters
will be as lovely as columns
in the corner of a palace.
13May our barns be filled
with all kinds of crops.
May our fields be covered
with sheep by the thousands,
14and every cow have calves.
Don't let our city be captured
or any of us be taken away,
and don't let cries of sorrow
be heard in our streets.
15Our Lord and our God,
you give these blessings
to all who worship you.
translation_text:
Matsɛ ko ye kunimi nɛ e na Mawu si
1Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi,
lɛ ji ye yi baalɔ.
E tsɔɔ mi bɔ nɛ a gbaa ta,
kɛ bɔ nɛ a miaa kɛ hwuu ta.
2Lɛ ji ye yi baalɔ, ye wesa he nitsɛnitsɛ, kɛ ye kpɔlɔ;
lɛ ji ye tsɛ̃i, nɛ e ngɔ i ya saa we ngɛ.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ baa ma a si kɛ woɔ ye sisi.
3 Yawɛ, mɛnɔ kulaa ji nɔmlɔ
nɛ o peeɔ e he akɔtaa,
loo nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ o susuɔ e he ɔ?
4Nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ kaa mumu nɛ a woɔ ɔ;
e ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa hɔ̃ nɛ bee kɛ yaa.
5Yawɛ, ha nɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ ba si,
nɛ o kple si kɛ ba.
Moo ta yo ɔmɛ a he,
konɛ a je la su ku.
6Ha nɛ oslabai nɛ gba,
nɛ o gbɛ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa;
tsɛ̃ o kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ,
nɛ o wo mɛ fo.
7Kpa o nine mi kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ o sá mi;
jé mi kɛ je nyu babauu ɔ mi;
jé mi kɛ je nibwɔhi a dɛ mi;
8a nya mi munyu ɔ, lakpa sɔuu,
nɛ a yeɔ lakpa kɛ kaa kita po.
9Mawu, ma la la he ha mo,
ma fia kpa saku nɛ hɛɛ kpa nyɔngma
kɛ je o yi.
10Mo lɛ o haa matsɛmɛ yeɔ kunimi,
nɛ o heɔ o tsɔlɔ David yi wami.
11He mi kɛ je klaate nɛ yeɔ awi ɔ nya,
mo kpɔ mi kɛ je nibwɔhi a dɛ mi,
nihi nɛ a nya mi munyu ɔ, lakpa sɔuu,
nɛ kita po a yeɔ lakpa kɛ kaa a.
12Ha nɛ wa binyumuhi nɛ ngɛ nihe mi ɔ,
a he nɛ wa kaa tso nɛ maa si saminya.
Ha nɛ wa biyihi nɛ a pee kaa tɛ titima
kɛ ha matsɛ mɔ fiami.
13Wa blɛfo gba amɛ nɛ a hyi tɔ kɛ ngma,
nɛ a na niye ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ;
wa to ɔmɛ hu nɛ a fɔ babauu akpeakpe abɔ ngɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi.
14Wa na amɛ hu nɛ a fɔ babauu ja nɔuu;
a mi ko sane;
nɛ a ko nu bubuubui ko
ngɛ wa gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
15Nihi nɛ a gbaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a bua maa jɔ.
Nihi nɛ Yawɛ ji a Mawu ɔ,
a bua maa jɔ.

english_text:
(By David for praise.)
The Lord Is Kind and Merciful
1I will praise you,
my God and King,
and always honor your name.
2I will praise you each day
and always honor your name.
3You are wonderful, Lord,
and you deserve all praise,
because you are much greater
than anyone can understand.
4Each generation will announce
to the next your wonderful
and powerful deeds.
5I will keep thinking about
your marvelous glory
and your mighty miracles.
6Everyone will talk about
your fearsome deeds,
and I will tell all nations
how great you are.
7They will celebrate and sing
about your matchless mercy
and your power to save.
8You are merciful, Lord!
You are kind and patient
and always loving.
9You are good to everyone,
and you take care
of all your creation.
10All creation will thank you,
and your loyal people
will praise you.
11They will tell about
your marvelous kingdom
and your power.
12Then everyone will know about
the mighty things you do
and your glorious kingdom.
13Your kingdom will never end,
and you will rule forever.
Our Lord, you keep your word
and do everything you say.
14When someone stumbles or falls,
you give a helping hand.
15Everyone depends on you,
and when the time is right,
you provide them with food.
16By your own hand you satisfy
the desires of all who live.
17Our Lord, everything you do
is kind and thoughtful,
18and you are near to everyone
whose prayers are sincere.
19You satisfy the desires
of all your worshipers,
and you come to save them
when they ask for help.
20You take care of everyone
who loves you,
but you destroy the wicked.
21I will praise you, Lord,
and everyone will respect
your holy name forever.
translation_text:
Yi jemi la
1Ye Mawu kɛ ye matsɛ,
ma wo o hɛ mi nyami,
nɛ ma na mo si daa.
2Ma na mo si daa ligbi,
nɛ ma je o yi kɛ maa ya neneene.
3Yawɛ kle, nɛ e sa kaa a je e yi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
E kle pe bɔ nɛ adesa juɛmi ma nyɛ maa su he.
4Yi nɔ kake ma je níhi nɛ o tsu ɔ a yi
kɛ tsɔɔ yi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ;
nɛ he wami níhi nɛ o tsu ɔ,
a maa sɛɛ kɛ ha mɛ.
5O hɛ mi nyami, o we agboje,
kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o tsu ɔ,
ma susu a he saminya.
6Nihi maa fiɛ nyakpɛ ní, kɛ ní nguanguahi
nɛ o pee ɔ,
nɛ imi hu ma fiɛ ke o kle niinɛ.
7A ma de ke o mi mi hi saminya.
A ma la boboobo ke daa nɛ ɔ,
nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ o peeɔ.
8Dloolɔ kɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ ji Yawɛ;
e mi mi fu we mla,
nɛ e suɔmi hiɛ babauu.
9Yawɛ peeɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ kpakpa,
nɛ e nuɔ nɔ́ he ha níhi tsuo nɛ e bɔ ɔ.
10Yawɛ, níhi nɛ o pee ɔ tsuo maa na mo si,
nɛ o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ma je o yi!
11A maa sɛɛ o matsɛ yemi ɔ
hɛ mi nyami ɔ he ní,
nɛ a ma de ke o kle saminya.
12Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo maa le ní nguanguahi nɛ o pee,
kɛ o matsɛ yemi ɔ we agboje.
13O matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ daa,
nɛ o nɔ yemi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Yawɛ yeɔ e siwo nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ,
nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e peeɔ ɔ hi saminya.
14Nihi nɛ ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, e piɛɔ a he,
nɛ nihi nɛ nɔ si ɔ, e woɔ a nɔ
kɛ daa si ekohu.
15Bɔ níhi tsuo nɛ wami ngɛ a mi ɔ,
mo pɛ nɛ a ngɛ blɔ hyɛe;
ejakaa mo lɛ o haa mɛ a niye ní
ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
16O bliɔ o dɛ mi,
nɛ o haa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle tɔɔ.
17Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ peeɔ ɔ da;
e naa mɔbɔ be tsuaa be.
18Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsɛɔ Yawɛ
ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ,
Yawɛ hɛɛ lɛ kɛ suu e he.
19Nihi nɛ yee lɛ gbeye ɔ,
e peeɔ a hiami ní kɛ haa mɛ.
E buu a kue fami ɔmɛ hu tue,
nɛ e heɔ a yi wami.
20Nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ Yawɛ ɔ,
e baa a yi;
se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ
e ma kpata a hɛ mi.
21Ma je Yawɛ yi,
nɛ ma ha nimli adesahi tsuo ma je e yi
kɛ maa ya neneene.

english_text:
Shout Praises to the Lord
1Shout praises to the Lord!
With all that I am,
I will shout his praises.
2I will sing and praise
the Lord God
as long as I live.
3You can't depend on anyone,
not even a great leader.
4Once they die and are buried,
that will be the end
of all their plans.
5The Lord God of Jacob blesses
everyone who trusts him
and depends on him.
6 God made heaven and earth;
he created the sea
and everything else.
God always keeps his word.
7He gives justice to the poor
and food to the hungry.
The Lord sets prisoners free
8and heals blind eyes.
He gives a helping hand
to everyone who falls.
The Lord loves good people
9and looks after strangers.
He defends the rights
of orphans and widows,
but destroys the wicked.
10The Lord God of Zion
will rule forever!
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Nyɛ je Mawu, yi wami helɔ ɔ yi
1Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Imi hu ma je Yawɛ yi!
2Be abɔ nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ,
ma je Yawɛ yi!
Ligbi abɔ nɛ i ngɛ wami mi nɛ ɔ,
ma la kɛ je ye Mawu ɔ yi!
3Nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ ganɔ ko,
loo nɔmlɔ adesa ko nɔ,
ejakaa e be he wami nɛ e ma he nyɛ yi wami.
4Ke nɔmlɔ gbo ɔ,
e kpaleɔ kɛ yaa zu mi ekohu,
jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu e yi mi tomi ɔmɛ tsuo a se poɔ.
5Nɔ nɛ Yakob Mawu ɔ ji e he piɛlɔ,
nɛ e ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ e Mawu ɔ nɔ ɔ,
a gbaa lɛ.
6 Mawu nɛ pee hiɔwe, zugba, wo,
kɛ a mi níhi tsuo,
nɛ e yeɔ e siwo nɔ daa.
7Nihi nɛ a waa mɛ yi mi ɔ,
e yeɔ a sane kɛ haa mɛ.
Nihi nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mɛ yee ɔ,
e haa mɛ niye ní.
Nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ,
e jeɔ mɛ.
8Yawɛ bliɔ hɛ yuyuili a hɛngmɛ;
Yawɛ woɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nɔ si a nɔ;
Yawɛ suɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
9Yawɛ baa nibwɔhi a yi;
e yeɔ yalɔyihi, kɛ awusahi a sane kɛ haa mɛ;
se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ
e haa a yi mi tomi peeɔ yaka.
10Yawɛ maa ye tsɛ daa.
Zion, o Mawu ɔ maa ye matsɛ
kɛ maa ya neneene.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

english_text:
Sing and Praise the Lord
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Our God is kind,
and it is right and good
to sing praises to him.
2The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem
and brings the people of Israel
back home again.
3He renews our hopes
and heals our bodies.
4He decided how many stars
there would be in the sky
and gave each one a name.
5Our Lord is great and powerful!
He understands everything.
6The Lord helps the oppressed,
but he smears the wicked
in the dirt.
7Celebrate and sing!
Play your harps
for the Lord our God.
8He fills the sky with clouds
and sends rain to the earth,
so that the hills
will be green with grass.
9He provides food for cattle
and for the young ravens,
when they cry out.
10The Lord doesn't care about
the strength of horses
or powerful armies.
11The Lord is pleased only
with those who worship him
and trust his love.
12Everyone in Jerusalem,
come and praise
the Lord your God!
13He makes your city gates strong
and blesses your people.
14God lets you live in peace,
and he gives you
the very best wheat.
15As soon as God speaks,
the earth obeys.
16He covers the ground with snow
like a blanket of wool,
and he scatters frost
like ashes on the ground.
17God sends down hailstones
like chips of rocks.
Who can stand the cold?
18At his command the ice melts,
the wind blows,
and streams begin to flow.
19God gave his laws and teachings
to the descendants of Jacob,
the nation of Israel.
20But he has not given his laws
to any other nation.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Nyɛ je Mawu Ope ɔ yi
1Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
E hi kaa a la kɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi;
ejakaa dloolɔ ji lɛ,
nɛ e sa kaa a la kɛ je e yi.
2Yawɛ ngɛ Yerusalem sisi toe ekohu;
e ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ gbɛ fĩa a
a nya buae kɛ ba.
3Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a tsui ku ɔ, e ngɛ mɛ tsae,
nɛ e ngɛ a pa amɛ a nɔ fie.
4E le dodoe ɔmɛ tsuo a yibɔ,
nɛ e kɛ a biɛhi tsɛɔ mɛ kakaaka.
5Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kle;
e ngɛ he wami babauu,
nɛ e nile hu a li nya.
6Yawɛ piɛɔ nihi nɛ a waa mɛ yi mi a he;
se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ
e sakee mɛ ngɔ fiaa si.
7Nyɛ la sina la ha Yawɛ;
nyɛɛ fia saku nɛ nyɛ la kɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi!
8Lɛ nɛ e ngɔɔ bɔku kɛ haa hiɔwe,
nɛ e haa hiɔmi nɛɛ kɛ pueɔ zugba a nɔ,
nɛ nga mumu puɛɔ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
9Lɛ nɛ e haa nga mi lohwehi niye ní,
nɛ ke kuakualabite bihi ngɛ pɛe hu,
lɛ nɛ e haa mɛ ní.
10Okpɔngɔ nɛ he wa tete po e bui;
fo tulɔ kpanaa hu pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ngɛ e hɛ mi.
11Se nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye,
nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ
kaa e maa na mɛ mɔbɔ daa a,
mɛɛ e naa a he bua jɔmi.
12Yerusalem, mo je Yawɛ yi!
Zion, mo je o Mawu ɔ yi!
13Ejakaa e peeɔ o we agbo ɔmɛ a se lami ní ɔmɛ kpɛii,
nɛ e gbaa o bimɛ ɔmɛ.
14E haa tue mi jɔmi baa o zugba a nɔ,
nɛ niye ní buu tɔ.
15Ke e wo gbi ɔ, a nuɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ,
nɛ a yeɔ nɔ nɔuu.
16E haa nɛ snoo nɛɔ kaa doti,
nɛ e gbɛɔ bɔ́ nɛ fi ɔ kɛ fĩaa kaa la zu.
17E haa gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛɔ kaa dongo tɛ.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa da e fĩɛ ɔ nya?
18Ke e fa a, gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔmɛ sileɔ;
e haa kɔɔhiɔ fiaa, kɛkɛ nyu ɔ bɔni nyɛɛmi.
19E wo Israel mlaa,
nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ a ja Mawu ha.
20E pee we kikɛ nɛ ɔ ha we ma ko ma ko hyɛ,
nɛ e mlaa amɛ hu, ma kpa ko li.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

english_text:
Come Praise the Lord
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Shout the Lord's praises
in the highest heavens.
2All of you angels,
and all who serve him above,
come and offer praise.
3Sun and moon,
and all of you bright stars,
come and offer praise.
4Highest heavens, and the water
above the highest heavens,
come and offer praise.
5Let all things praise
the name of the Lord,
because they were created
at his command.
6He made them to last forever,
and nothing can change
what he has done.
7All creatures on earth,
you obey his commands,
so come praise the Lord!
8Sea monsters and the deep sea,
fire and hail, snow and frost,
and every stormy wind,
come praise the Lord!
9All mountains and hills,
fruit trees and cedars,
10every wild and tame animal,
all reptiles and birds,
come praise the Lord!
11Every king and every ruler,
all nations on earth,
12every man and every woman,
young people and old,
come praise the Lord!
13All creation, come praise
the name of the Lord.
Praise his name alone.
The glory of God is greater
than heaven and earth.
14Like a bull with mighty horns,
the Lord protects
his faithful nation Israel,
because they belong to him.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Je ɔ tsuo nɛ je Mawu yi
1Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi kɛ je hiɔwe.
Nyɛ je e yi ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo!
2Nyɛ Mawu bɔfohi tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!
Nyɛ e ta a tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!
3Pu, kɛ nyɔhiɔ, nyɛ je e yi!
Nyɛ dodoehi tsuo nɛ kpɛɔ, nyɛ je e yi!
4Nyɛ hiɔwe tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!
Nyu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe yi mi, mo je e yi!
5Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a je Yawɛ yi;
ejakaa lɛ nɛ e fa
nɛ a bɔ mɛ.
6E ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ma si kɛ yaa neneene.
E wo huzu ha mɛ, nɛ a be hanee.
7Nyɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo,
nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ wo mi lo nguanguahi, kɛ muɔ voovoohi tsuo,
nyɛ je e yi!
8La, gbiɛ ngo ngu, snoo, bɔ nɛ fi,
kɛ ahumi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Yawɛ tsɔmi nɔ,
nyɛ je e yi!
9Yo nguanguahi, kɛ yo wawi tsuo,
tsohi nɛ woɔ yiblii, kɛ seda tsohi tsuo,
10nga mi lohwehi, kɛ we mi lohwehi tsuo,
lohwehi nɛ sãã si, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ,
nyɛ je e yi!
11Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ, kɛ ma amɛ tsuo,
ganɔhi, kɛ ma nɔ yeli tsuo,
12nihewi kɛ yihewi tsuo,
nikɔtɔmahi kɛ jokuɛwi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ,
nyɛ je e yi!
13Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a je Yawɛ yi,
ejakaa lɛ nɔ kake too lɛ ngɛ biɛ nɛ kle agbo;
e hɛ mi nyami ha zugba a nɔ tsuo
kɛ be hiɔwe tete he.
14E to e ma a sisi kɛ he wami saminya.
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ma a tsuo ngɛ e yi jee;
e ma a ji Israel,
nɛ e he jua wa ha lɛ kaa nɔ́ ko.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

english_text:
A New Song of Praise
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Sing him a new song of praise
when his loyal people meet.
2People of Israel, rejoice
because of your Creator.
People of Zion, celebrate
because of your King.
3Praise his name by dancing
and playing music on harps
and tambourines.
4The Lord is pleased
with his people,
and he gives victory
to those who are humble.
5All of you faithful people,
praise our glorious Lord!
Celebrate and worship.
6 Praise God with songs
on your lips
and a sword in your hand.
7Take revenge and punish
the nations.
8Put chains of iron
on their kings and rulers.
9Punish them as they deserve;
this is the privilege
of God's faithful people.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Yi jemi la
1Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ la la he kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Nyɛ je e yi ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kpe ɔ mi!
2Israel, nya o bɔlɔ ɔ he.
Zion bi, nyɛ nya nyɛ matsɛ ɔ he.
3Á do nɛ a kɛ je e yi.
Á la nɛ a fiɛ do, nɛ a fia saku
kɛ je e yi.
4Ejakaa Yawɛ naa e ma a he bua jɔmi.
E haa nihi nɛ baa a he si yeɔ kunimi.
5Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ a hwɔ lele
kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ye kunimi niinɛ,
nɛ a la kɛ bua jɔmi nyɔ mi tsuo.
6Á la kɛ he wami kɛ je Mawu yi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, á hɛɛ klaate nya enyɔtsɛ
ngɛ a dɛ mi,
7konɛ a kɛ gbla je ma amɛ a tue
ngɛ yayami nɛ a pee ɔ he.
8Á wo a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ,
nɛ a we ablade ɔmɛ ɔ,
a bɔ mɛ dade pã;
9a gbla je ma amɛ a tue
kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma kɛ to ɔ.
Mawu ma a tsuo ye kunimi!
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

english_text:
The Lord Is Good to His People
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Praise God in his temple.
Praise him in heaven,
his mighty fortress.
2Praise our God!
His deeds are wonderful,
too marvelous to describe.
3Praise God with trumpets
and all kinds of harps.
4Praise him with tambourines
and dancing,
with stringed instruments
and woodwinds.
5Praise God with cymbals,
with clashing cymbals.
6Let every living creature
praise the Lord.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi
1Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ je Mawu yi ngɛ e he klɔuklɔu ɔ;
nyɛ je e yi ngɛ e bɔku kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi!
2Nyɛ je e yi ngɛ he wami níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ a he;
nyɛ je e yi, ejakaa e kle agbo.
3Nyɛ kpa titimati kɛ je e yi,
nyɛ je e yi kɛ saku, kɛ kpa saku!
4Nyɛɛ fia miɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ do kɛ je e yi;
nyɛ je e yi kɛ kpa saku, kɛ bɛ!
5Nyɛ je e yi kɛ gɔgɔ nɛ nya wa;
nyɛ je e yi kɛ gɔgɔ nɛ jijeɔ!
6Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ woɔ mumi ɔ,
e je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.

english_text:
How Proverbs Can Be Used
1 These are the proverbs
of King Solomon of Israel,
the son of David.
2Proverbs will teach you
wisdom and self-control
and how to understand
sayings with deep meanings.
3You will learn what is right
and honest and fair.
4From these, an ordinary person
can learn to be smart,
and young people can gain
knowledge and good sense.
5If you are already wise,
you will become even wiser.
And if you are smart,
you will learn to understand
6proverbs and sayings,
as well as words of wisdom,
and all kinds of riddles.
7 Respect and obey the Lord!
This is the beginning
of knowledge.
Only a fool rejects wisdom
and good advice.
Warnings against Bad Friends
8My child, obey the teachings
of your parents,
9and wear their teachings
as you would a pretty hat
or a lovely necklace.
10Don't be tempted by sinners
or listen 11when they say,
“Come on! Let's gang up
and kill somebody,
just for the fun of it!
12They're well and healthy now,
but we'll finish them off
once and for all.
13We'll take their valuables
and fill our homes
with stolen goods.
14If you join our gang,
you'll get your share.”
15Don't follow anyone like that
or do what they do.
16They are in a big hurry
to commit some crime,
perhaps even murder.
17They are like a bird
that sees the bait,
but ignores the trap.
18They gang up to murder someone,
but they are the victims.
19The wealth you get from crime
robs you of your life.
Wisdom Speaks
20 Wisdom shouts in the streets
wherever crowds gather.
21She shouts in the marketplaces
and near the city gates
as she says to the people,
22“How much longer
will you enjoy
being stupid fools?
Won't you ever stop sneering
and laughing at knowledge?
23Listen as I correct you
and tell you what I think.
24You completely ignored me
and refused to listen;
25you rejected my advice
and paid no attention
when I warned you.
26“So when you are struck
by some terrible disaster,
27or when trouble and distress
surround you like a whirlwind,
I will laugh and make fun.
28You will ask for my help,
but I won't listen;
you will search,
but you won't find me.
29No, you would not learn,
and you refused
to respect the Lord.
30You rejected my advice
and paid no attention
when I warned you.
31“Now you will eat the fruit
of what you have done,
until you are stuffed full
with your own schemes.
32Sin and self-satisfaction
bring destruction and death
to stupid fools.
33But if you listen to me,
you will be safe and secure
without fear of disaster.”
translation_text:
Abɛhi a he se nami
1 Israel matsɛ, Salomo, David bi ɔ abɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
2Abɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ma ha nɛ o maa le ní; a maa wo mo ga kpakpa, nɛ a ma ha nɛ o maa nu sanehi nɛ a mi kuɔ a sisi. 3Abɛ ɔmɛ maa tsɔɔ mo anɔkuale yemi, dami sane yemi, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ da peemi. 4Nɔ nɛ li nɔ́ ɔ, abɛ ɔmɛ ma ha nɛ e nɔ bɔ ma tsɔ; se niheyo lɛɛ e ma na juɛmi, kɛ hɛ mi si kami. 5Ke ní lelɔ nu abɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e nile ɔ maa hiɛ kɛ pue nɔ; juɛmitsɛ hu e juɛmi ɔ mi ma blɛke pe kekle ɔ, 6konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a nu abɛhi, kɛ ní leli a munyuhi nɛ a mi kuɔ ɔ a sisi saminya.
A wo nihewi ga
7 Loko o ma na nile ɔ, ja o ye Yawɛ gbeye. Kuasiahi bui nile, nɛ slɔmi gbi hu a sume.
8Ye bi, ke o tsɛ ngɛ mo tsɔsee ɔ, bu tue! Ke o nyɛ hu ngɛ mo ní tsɔɔe ɔ, ko kua! 9Ejakaa lɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ma dla mo nɛ o ba o je mi saminya, kaa bɔ nɛ duku kpakpa, loo kuɛ ní haa nɔ he peeɔ fɛu ɔ.
10Ye bi, ke yayami peeli ngɛ mo mlɔɔe ɔ, koo nyɛɛ a se. 11Ke a de mo ke, “Ha nɛ waa ho nɛ wa ya hla nɔ ko waa gbe! Ha wa ya wo nɔ ko nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko ka, nɛ waa gbe lɛ yaka gu! 12Waa mii mɛ hɛ ngmengmle kaa a yaa gbeje; waa ngɔ mɛ kaa yɔkɔ ngɔɔ gbogboe, be mi nɛ a ngɛ kpakpataa! 13Wa ma na ní kpakpahi nɛ a he jua wa babauu, nɛ wa we ɔmɛ ma hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ níhi nɛ wa ha. 14Ba piɛ wa he. Ke wa ná nɔ́ ko ɔ, wɔ tsuo wa maa dla lɛ fiee!”
15Ye bi, o kɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli ko bɔ. Koo nyɛɛ a se. 16A he sɔɔ kɛ yayami peemi; a he sɔɔ kɛ pueɔ muɔ si. 17Ke lohwe pɛlitsɛ ngɛ mo hyɛe nɛ o tsɔ lɛ klama a, o tsu yaka ní. 18Se nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he klama a tsɔ ɔ nɛ; mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛ a maa du klama a, nɛ a ma gbo. 19Nihi tsuo nɛ guu awi yemi mi kɛ naa ní ɔ, bɔ nɛ a nyagbe ya baa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; awi yemi mi nɔuu a gboɔ ngɛ.
Nile wo gbi
20 Nile ngɛ ngmlaa kpae boboobo ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ, kɛ jua mi. 21E ngɛ kpae boboobo ngɛ ma agbo ɔmɛ a nya, kɛ hehi tsuo nɛ nihi buaa a he nya ngɛ. E ngɛ dee ke,
22“Kuasiahi! Mɛni be nyɛ maa biɛ kɛ yaa si? Fɛu yeli! Mɛni be nyɛ maa ye fɛu kɛ yaa si? Anɛ nyɛ be ní kasee? 23Nyɛɛ bu tue nɛ ma ka nyɛ hɛ mi. Ma wo nyɛ ga kpakpa, nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa tu nile munyu. 24I hla nyɛ se blɔ, nɛ i tsɛ nyɛ si abɔ ke nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ. Se nyɛ bui fɛɛ. 25Ga tsuo nɛ i wo nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɔɛ, nɛ nyɛ kplɛɛ we kaa ma kua nɔ́ ha nyɛ. 26Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke haomi ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, imi hu ma muɔ nyɛ. Ke nyɛ hɛ dɔ ɔ, ma ye nyɛ he fɛu. 27Ke haomi ba nyɛ nɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa lɛ ngɛ fiae, nɛ amanehlu ba na nyɛ kaa lasiogblee, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui yee ɔ, 28jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ma tsɛ mi, se i be nɔ hee. Nyɛ ma hla ye se blɔ kɛ hɛdɔ, nɛ nyɛ be mi nae. 29Ejakaa nyɛ bui nile he akɔtaa; Yawɛ hu, nyɛ yi lɛ gbeye. 30Nyɛ sume ga womi; nɛ ke i ka nyɛ hɛ mi hu, nyɛ kplɛɛ we. 31Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ tsu ɔ, lɔ ɔ he hiɔwo nyɛ ma na; nyɛ ní yaya amɛ nɔuu maa hao nyɛ. 32Kuasiahi gboɔ, ejakaa a bui nile; a heɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he yeɔ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kpataa a hɛ mi. 33Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buɔ mi tue ɔ, e maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ e be gbeye yee kaa haomi ko maa ba e nɔ.”

english_text:
Wisdom and Bad Friends
1My child, you must follow
and treasure my teachings
and my instructions.
2Keep in tune with wisdom
and think what it means
to have common sense.
3Beg as loud as you can
for good common sense.
4Search for wisdom
as you would search for silver
or hidden treasure.
5Then you will understand
what it means to respect
and to know the Lord God.
6 All wisdom comes from the Lord,
and so do common sense
and understanding.
7God gives helpful advice
to everyone who obeys him
and protects those
who live as they should.
8God sees that justice is done,
and he watches over everyone
who is faithful to him.
9With wisdom you will learn
what is right
and honest and fair.
10Wisdom will control your mind,
and you will be pleased
with knowledge.
11Sound judgment and good sense
will watch over you.
12Wisdom will protect you
from evil schemes
and from those liars
13who turned from doing good
to live in the darkness.
14Most of all they enjoy
being mean and deceitful.
15They are dishonest themselves,
and so are all their deeds.
Wisdom and Sexual Purity
16Wisdom will protect you
from the smooth talk
of a sinful woman,
17who breaks her wedding vows
and leaves the man she married
when she was young.
18The road to her house leads
down
to the dark world
of the dead.
19Visit her, and you will never
find the road to life again.
20Follow the example
of good people
and live an honest life.
21If you are honest and innocent,
you will keep your land;
22if you do wrong
and can never be trusted,
you will be rooted out.
translation_text:
Nile he se namihi
1Ye bi, bu ye munyu ɔmɛ tue, nɛ o pɛtɛ ye mlaa amɛ a he saminya. 2Bu nile munyu tue, nɛ o bɔ mɔde kaa o maa nu sisi lo. 3Ee, moo fa kue nɛ a ha mo nile; kpa pɛɛ nɛ a ha mo nɔ́ sisi numi. 4Hla e se blɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a hlaa sika hiɔ, loo juetli nɛ a ngɔ kɛ laa. 5Ke o pee ja loko o maa nu Yawɛ gbeye yemi sisi, nɛ o maa kase Mawu he nile. 6Yawɛ lɛ haa nɔ nile; lɛ nɛ e tsɔɔ nɔ nile, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi. 7Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, Yawɛ piɛɔ a he, nɛ e baa a yi. 8Yawɛ buu dami sane yeli a he, nɛ e baa e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a yi.
9Ke o bu mi tue ɔ, o maa le nɔ́ nɛ hi, kɛ blɔ nɔ́ nɛ da. O maa le nɔ́ nɛ sa mo peemi. 10O maa le ní, nɛ nile ɔ ma ha mo bua jɔmi. 11O he nile, kɛ o nɔ́ sisi numi maa bu o he, 12nɛ a be hae nɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ. A ma je mo kɛ je nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi: nihi nɛ a kɛ a lilɛ puɛɔ nɔ, 13nihi nɛ gba kɛ je blɔ nɛ da nɔ kɛ ya ngɛ diblii blɔhi a nɔ nyɛɛe, 14nihi nɛ nyaa yayami peemi he, nɛ a naa bua jɔmi ke a ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ pee, 15kɛ nihi nɛ a blɔhi dɛ, nɛ a kɛ hɛ fɔ we a nɔ.
16Ke o bu mi tue ɔ, lɛɛ yo yaholɔ ko nɛ ma hla kaa e kɛ e nya mi munyu ngɔngɔɛ ma puɛ o tue ɔ, ma je mo kɛ je e dɛ mi: 17yo nɛ kua e yihe mi huno, nɛ si nɛ e wo e Mawu ɔ hu e yi nɔ. 18Ke o ya e we mi ɔ, gbenɔ blɔ nɔ o ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ nɛ. Ke o ya lejɛ ɔ lɛɛ o su gbeje ta. 19Nɔ ko ya slaa we lɛ, nɛ e kpale kɛ ba hyɛ. Ke nɔ ko ya su lejɛ ɔ, e kpale we e se kɛ bɛ wami blɔ ɔ nɔ hu. 20Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo kase nimli kpakpahi a ní peepee, konɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ da. 21Dali, kɛ nimli kpakpahi ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa hi zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ. 22Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ yayami peeli lɛɛ Mawu ma kpata a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a hiaa tso ngɛ zu mi kɛ fɔɔ si ɔ.

english_text:
Trust God
1My child, remember
my teachings and instructions
and obey them completely.
2They will help you live
a long and prosperous life.
3Let love and loyalty
always show like a necklace,
and write them in your mind.
4 God and people will like you
and hold you in high esteem.
5With all your heart
you must trust the Lord
and not your own judgment.
6Always let him lead you,
and he will clear the road
for you to follow.
7 Don't ever think that you
are wise enough,
but respect the Lord
and stay away from evil.
8This will make you healthy,
and you will feel strong.
9Honor the Lord by giving him
your money and the first part
of all your crops.
10Then you will have
more grain and grapes
than you will ever need.
11 My child, don't turn away
or become bitter
when the Lord corrects you.
12 The Lord corrects
everyone he loves,
just as parents correct
a child they dearly love.
The Value of Wisdom
13God blesses everyone
who has wisdom
and common sense.
14Wisdom is worth more
than silver;
it makes you much richer
than gold.
15Wisdom is more valuable
than precious jewels;
nothing you want
compares with her.
16In her right hand
Wisdom holds a long life,
and in her left hand
are wealth and honor.
17Wisdom makes life pleasant
and leads us safely along.
18Wisdom is a life-giving tree,
the source of happiness
for all who hold on to her.
19By his wisdom and knowledge
the Lord created
heaven and earth.
20By his understanding
he let the ocean break loose
and clouds release the rain.
21My child, use common sense
and sound judgment!
Always keep them in mind.
22They will help you to live
a long and beautiful life.
23You will walk safely
and never stumble;
24you will rest without a worry
and sleep soundly.
25So don't be afraid
of sudden disasters
or storms that strike
those who are evil.
26You can be sure that the Lord
will protect you from harm.
27 Do all you can for everyone
who deserves your help.
28Don't tell your neighbor
to come back tomorrow,
if you can help today.
29Don't try to be mean
to neighbors who trust you.
30Don't argue just to be arguing,
when you haven't been hurt.
31Don't be jealous
of cruel people
or follow their example.
32The Lord doesn't like
anyone who is dishonest,
but he lets good people
be his friends.
33He places a curse on the home
of everyone who is evil,
but he blesses the home
of every good person.
34 The Lord sneers at those
who sneer at him,
but he is kind to everyone
who is humble.
35You will be praised
if you are wise,
but you will be disgraced
if you are a stubborn fool.
translation_text:
A wo nihewi kɛ yihewi ga
1Ye bi, níhi nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ɔ, o hɛ ko je a nɔ; o hɛ nɛ hi mlaahi nɛ i wo mo ɔ a nɔ be tsuaa be. 2Ke o pee ja a, o wami se maa kɛ, nɛ o ma na he jɔmi, kɛ kplɔkɔtɔ. 3Koo ngmɛɛ si himi kpakpa, kɛ anɔkuale yemi he. Fi kɛ wo o kuɛ, nɛ o ngma kɛ fɔ o tsui nɔ. 4 Ke o pee ja a, o hɛ mi maa ba nyami, nɛ Mawu, kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo ma na o he bua jɔmi.
5Ngɔɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ kulaa. Koo ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ́ nɛ moo o susu kaa o le ɔ nɔ. 6Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, mo kai Yawɛ, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ mo blɔ nɛ da. 7 Koo bu o he ní lelɔ; moo ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ o tu yayami nya fo. 8Ke o pee ja a, e ngɛ kaa tsopa kpakpa nɛ ma tsa mo, nɛ ma ha o he mi maa jɔ mo. 9Ngɔɔ o ní babauu ɔ kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami; ngɔɔ o niba ní tsuo mi kekleekle nɔ́ kɛ sã bɔ ha lɛ. 10Ke o pee ja a, o blɛfo gba a ma hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ blɛfo; o wai hu maa ba babauu nɛ o nine be he kpee.
11 Ye bi, ke Yawɛ ngɛ mo tsɔsee ɔ, e ko pee mo tai; ke e ngɛ o hɛ mi kae ɔ, o ko de ke e ngɛ mo haoe. 12 Nihi nɛ Yawɛ suɔ mɛ ɔ, a hɛ mi e kaa, kaa bɔ nɛ tsɛ peeɔ e bi nɛ e suɔ ɔ. 13Nɔmlɔ nɛ le ní, nɛ e nuɔ nɔ́ sisi ɔ, a gbaa lɛ saminya. 14Ejakaa e he ngɛ se nami pe sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ. 15Nile he ngɛ se nami kulaa pe june; nɔ́ ko be nɛ o suɔ saminya nɛ a kɛ maa to nile he. 16Nile haa nɔ wami se kɛɔ ngɛ je mi; e haa nɔ naa ní, nɛ e haa nɔ hɛ mi baa nyami. 17Nile haa nɔ bua jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi. 18Nihi nɛ le ní ɔ, a naa bua jɔmi; nile haa mɛ wami.
19Nile Yawɛ kɛ bɔ je ɔ.
Ga lɛ e kɛ ngɔ hiɔwe ngɔ to e blɔ he.
20E nile ɔ nɛ ha nɛ pa amɛ hia;
lɛ nɛ ha nyu je bɔku ɔmɛ a mi pue zugba.
21Ye bi, ngɔɔ nile nitsɛnitsɛ,
kɛ juɛmi ngɔ to saminya; ko ha nɛ a je o dɛ.
22A ma ha mo he wami, nɛ o ma na bua jɔmi. 23Kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa nyɛɛ tɛɛ ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ o be nɔ́ tɛe. 24Ke o hwɔ si ɔ, o be gbeye yee; o maa hwɔ mahe vii nyɔ mi tsuo. 25Haomihi nɛ baa yiwutsotsɛmɛ a nɔ tlukaa kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa a, lɔ ɔmɛ be o he gbeye woe. 26Yawɛ maa bu o he. E be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ o ya du klama.
27Be tsuaa be nɛ o ma nyɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ e hia kaa a pee mɛ kpakpa a, pee mɛ kpakpa. 28Ke nɔ́ ko ngɛ o dɛ nɛ o ma nyɛ kɛ pee o nyɛmi kpakpa a, ko de lɛ ke e ya nɛ e ba hwɔɔ loko o ha lɛ. 29O nyɛmi nɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ ɔ, koo to ga yayami kɛ wo e he. 30O kɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko pɛ yaka gu be mi nɛ e pee we mo nɔ́ yaya ko. 31O hɛ ko kɔ̃ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a nɔ; níhi nɛ a peeɔ hu, ko hla kaa o maa pee. 32Ejakaa Yawɛ sume nimli yayamihi; nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛ e kɛ bɔɔ. 33Yawɛ gbiɛmi ngɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a wehi a nɔ, se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ a hi he ɔ, gbaami sɔuu. 34 Yawɛ kɛ he nɔ woli bɔɛ; se nihi nɛ baa a he si lɛɛ e naa mɛ mɔbɔ. 35Ní leli a hɛ mi maa ba nyami, se kuasiahi lɛɛ a hɛ mi ma pue si.

english_text:
Advice to Young People
1My child, listen closely
to my teachings
and learn common sense.
2My advice is useful,
so don't turn away.
3When I was still very young
and my mother's favorite child,
my father 4said to me:
“If you follow my teachings
and keep them in mind,
you will live.
5Be wise and learn good sense;
remember my teachings
and do what I say.
6“If you love Wisdom
and don't reject her,
she will watch over you.
7The best thing about Wisdom
is Wisdom herself;
good sense is more important
than anything else.
8If you value Wisdom
and hold tightly to her,
great honors will be yours.
9It will be like wearing
a glorious crown
of beautiful flowers.”
The Right Way and the Wrong Way
10My child, if you listen
and obey my teachings,
you will live a long time.
11I have shown you the way
that makes sense;
I have guided you
along the right path.
12Your road won't be blocked,
and you won't stumble
when you run.
13Hold firmly to my teaching
and never let go.
It will mean life for you.
14Don't follow the bad example
of cruel and evil people.
15Turn aside and keep going.
Stay away from them.
16They can't sleep or rest
until they do wrong or harm
some innocent victim.
17Their food and drink
are cruelty and wickedness.
18The lifestyle of good people
is like sunlight at dawn
that keeps getting brighter
until broad daylight.
19The lifestyle of the wicked
is like total darkness,
and they will never know
what makes them stumble.
20My child, listen carefully
to everything I say.
21Don't forget a single word,
but think about it all.
22Knowing these teachings
will mean true life
and good health for you.
23Carefully guard your thoughts
because they are the source
of true life.
24Never tell lies or be deceitful
in what you say.
25Keep looking straight ahead,
without turning aside.
26 Know where you are headed,
and you will stay
on solid ground.
27Don't make a mistake by turning
to the right or the left.
translation_text:
Nile he se namihi
1Ye bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ tsɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ tue saminya, konɛ nyɛɛ le ní. 2Nɔ́ kpakpa lɛ i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ; nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ he. 3Tsaatsɛ kɛ maa a bi kake too ji mi. Benɛ jokuɛyo bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ ji mi ɔ, 4tsaatsɛ tsɔɔ mi ní. Nɔ́ nɛ e pɔɔ mi demi ji, “Mo kai níhi nɛ i de mo ɔ, nɛ o hɛ ko je a nɔ gblegbleegble. Moo ye mlaa nɛ i wo mo ɔ nɔ, konɛ o yi nɛ na wami. 5Moo le ní, nɛ o nu ní a sisi. Níhi nɛ i de mo ɔ, o hɛ ko je a nɔ. 6Ko si nile se kɔkɔɔkɔ. Suɔ nile, konɛ e baa o yi, nɛ e bu o he. 7Nile ji nɔ́ nɛ he hia pe kulaa. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, hla nile se blɔ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma ná a, kɛ hla ní a sisi numi. 8Bu nile, nɛ e maa pee mo nɔmlɔ ngua; fua lɛ atuu, nɛ e maa wo o hɛ mi nyami. 9E maa pee kunimi yemi jlasi nɛ a kɛ fi o yi.”
10Ye bi, bu mi tue. Munyuhi nɛ i tu mo ɔ, moo ngɔ, konɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ je mi. 11I tsɔɔ mo nile, kɛ blɔ nɛ da nɛ sa nɛ o nyɛɛ nɔ. 12Ke o ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, o be nɔ́ tɛe; ke o ngɛ fo tue ɔ, o be si nɔe. 13Kai slɔmi gbi nɛ a ha mo ɔ daa; koo ngmɛɛ he. Lɔ ɔ ji o wami. 14Koo ya he nɛ yayami peeli ngɛ. Ko ya nyɛɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a se. 15Ee, moo yu o he; koo ya lejɛ ɔ! Gba blɔ nɛ o be kɛ ho. 16Ke yiwutsotsɛmɛ pee we nɔ́ yayami ko ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a hwɔɔ mahe. Mahe jeɔ a hɛ mi kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ a yeɔ nɔ ko awi loko a hwɔɔ mahe. 17Yayami peemi ji abolo nɛ a yeɔ, nɛ basabasa ji wai nɛ a nuɔ.
18Blɔ nɛ dali nyɛɛɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa mɔtu pu la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe hluu kɛ yaa si piani. 19Yayami peeli lɛɛ a blɔ nɔ woɔ diblii kpii kaa nyɔ mi. A tɛɔ nɔ́ nɛ a nɔɔ si, se a li nɔ́ nɛ ji.
20Ye bi, bu ye munyu ɔmɛ tue, nɛ o nu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee ɔ saminya. 21O hɛ ko je munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ. Ngɔɔ kɛ to o tsui mi tɔɔ. 22Nɔ nɛ nuɔ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi ɔ, e naa wami nɛ e hii nɔmlɔ tso he wami saminya be tsuaa be. 23Susu o yi mi saminya loko o pee nɔ́ ko, ejakaa lɔ ɔ nɔ o wami daa si ngɛ. 24Nɔ́ ko nɛ pi anɔkuale ɔ, ko de. Lakpa munyu, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ kaa ja kó je o nya mi. 25Hyɛ o hɛ mi tɛɛ. Ko plɛ o yi kɛ ya hiɛ, loo hiɛ. 26 Ke o maa pee nɔ́ ko ɔ, susu he saminya. Ja o pee ja loko o blɔhi maa da mo. 27Koo pee yayami. Ko gba kɛ je blɔ nɛ da nɔ; yaa o hɛ mi tɛɛ.

english_text:
Be Faithful to Your Wife
1My son, if you listen closely
to my wisdom and good sense,
2you will have sound judgment,
and you will always know
the right thing to say.
3The words of an immoral woman
may be as sweet as honey
and as smooth as olive oil.
4But all that you really get
from being with her
is bitter poison and pain.
5If you follow her,
she will lead you down
to the world of the dead.
6She has missed the path
that leads to life
and doesn't even know it.
7My son, listen to me
and do everything I say.
8Stay away from a bad woman!
Don't even go near the door
of her house.
9You will lose your self-respect
and end up in debt
to some cruel person
for the rest of your life.
10Strangers will get your money
and everything else
you have worked for.
11When it's all over,
your body will waste away,
as you groan 12and shout,
“I hated advice and correction!
13I paid no attention
to my teachers,
14and now I am disgraced
in front of everyone.”
15You should be faithful
to your wife,
just as you take water
from your own well.
16And don't be like a stream
from which just any woman
may take a drink.
17Save yourself for your wife
and don't have sex
with other women.
18Be happy with the wife
